objective.key: Explain seasons using axial tilt, not distance from the Sun, and predict which hemisphere is in summer on a given date.
objective.zh: 用地轴倾斜解释四季，而非日地距离，并判断指定日期哪个半球处于夏季。

why.key: Earth’s axis keeps nearly the same direction through a year. Tilt changes both noon solar altitude and the length of daylight. Northern and southern seasonal illumination is opposite: when London has its longest days, Sydney has its shortest. Temperature also depends on heat storage, atmosphere and surroundings, which this model does not calculate.
why.zh: 一年中，地轴大致指向同一方向。倾角改变正午太阳高度和日长，使南北半球季节性光照相反：伦敦白昼最长时，悉尼白昼最短。温度还受储热、大气及周围环境影响，本模型不计算这些因素。

why.key: The baseline orbit is deliberately circular so tilt can be isolated. Orbit stretch changes a hypothetical eccentricity from 0 to 0.4. Motion follows Kepler’s equation, so a stretched orbit moves faster near perihelion. Earth’s actual eccentricity is about 0.0167 and its perihelion is in early January; that calendar alignment is not represented by this March-origin experiment.
why.zh: 默认圆轨道用于单独观察倾角作用。轨道拉伸将假想偏心率调至 0–0.4，运动遵循开普勒方程，近日点附近更快。地球实际偏心率约 0.0167，一月初过近日点；这一实际日历关系不由本实验的三月起点表示。

why.key: March, June, September and December labels mark seasonal directions for the circular baseline. At nonzero eccentricity those directions are not equally spaced in time, and the Year slider is model-year progress rather than a calendar date. The gold axis maintains its direction. The two surface markers identify London and Sydney; their geometric daylight lengths appear below the view.
why.zh: 三月、六月、九月、十二月标记圆轨道下的季节方向。偏心率不为零时，这些方向对应的时间间隔不相等；年份滑块表示模型年进程，不是精确日期。金色地轴保持方向，两地标记对应伦敦和悉尼，下方显示几何日长。

why.key: Earth and the Sun are enlarged by different amounts for visibility. T restores their radii to the orbital-distance scale; Earth then becomes too small to resolve on many screens. Labels and the axis remain enlarged locators. Daylight uses a geometric horizon, excluding refraction, the Sun’s finite disc and local terrain. Set tilt to zero and circular orbit to compare 12-hour days outside the exact poles.
why.zh: 为便于观察，太阳和地球按不同倍数放大。T 恢复半径与轨道距离的共同尺度，地球可能小到难以辨认，标签与地轴仍是放大的定位符号。日长采用几何地平线，不计折射、太阳视圆面和地形；圆轨道、零倾角时，除精确极点外均可比较约 12 小时日照。

steps.key: Keep Orbit stretch at 0 and set Axial tilt to 0°. Play a year and read the two 12-hour daylight values. Switch to Earth close-up to inspect the terminator and axis.
steps.zh: 将轨道拉伸设为 0、地轴倾角设为 0°。播放一年，比较两地约 12 小时的日长；切到地球近景，观察晨昏线和地轴。

steps.key: Set tilt to 23.44° and pause at the June direction, then December. Compare London with Sydney and trace the fixed axis direction.
steps.zh: 把倾角设为 23.44°，分别在六月、十二月方向暂停。比较伦敦与悉尼，并观察地轴方向保持不变。

steps.key: Change Orbit stretch; distinguish a hypothetical orbit from Earth’s actual January perihelion. Press T, then restore the enlarged view.
steps.zh: 改变轨道拉伸，区分假想轨道与地球一月初过近日点的实际情况。按 T 查看真实比例，再恢复放大视图。

steps.key: 4 questions with explanations. Give a reason for each choice; there is no score gate.
steps.zh: 4 道题，附解析。请说明选择理由。

script.key:
Keep Orbit stretch at 0 and set Axial tilt to 0°.
Play a year and read the two 12-hour daylight values. Switch to Earth close-up to inspect the terminator and axis.
Set tilt to 23.44° and pause at the June direction, then December.
Compare London with Sydney and trace the fixed axis direction.
Change Orbit stretch; distinguish a hypothetical orbit from Earth’s actual January perihelion.
Press T, then restore the enlarged view.
Finish in Check.
script.zh:
将轨道拉伸设为 0、地轴倾角设为 0°。播放一年，比较两地约 12 小时的日长；切到地球近景，观察晨昏线和地轴。
把倾角设为 23.44°，分别在六月、十二月方向暂停。比较伦敦与悉尼，并观察地轴方向保持不变。
改变轨道拉伸，区分假想轨道与地球一月初过近日点的实际情况。按 T 查看真实比例，再恢复放大视图。
最后完成自测，请学生说明判断依据。

pitfalls.key: Reading model-year progress as a precise calendar date.
pitfalls.zh: 不要把模型年进程当成精确日历。

pitfalls.key: Calling seasonal illumination a temperature forecast.
pitfalls.zh: 季节性光照不是气温预报。

pitfalls.key: Treating an enlarged Earth or axis as the orbit-distance scale.
pitfalls.zh: 放大的地球和地轴不采用轨道距离比例。

misconceptions.key: Summer happens because Earth is closer to the Sun.
misconceptions.zh: 夏季是因为地球离太阳更近。

misconceptions.key: Seasons are a tilt effect. Earth is actually nearest the Sun in early January, during northern winter.
misconceptions.zh: 四季主要由地轴倾斜造成。地球一月初离太阳最近，此时北半球正值冬季。

misconceptions.key: The axis wobbles each year, pointing first north then south.
misconceptions.zh: 地轴每年摇摆，交替指向南北。

misconceptions.key: Over one year the axis stays pointed the same way, near Polaris. The hemisphere that leans toward the Sun changes because Earth has moved around the orbit.
misconceptions.zh: 一年中地轴大致保持指向北极星附近。朝向太阳的半球改变，是因为地球沿轨道移动。

misconceptions.key: The equator has no seasons, so the Sun is always overhead there.
misconceptions.zh: 赤道没有四季，所以太阳每天都直射赤道。

misconceptions.key: Equatorial day length stays near 12 hours, but noon altitude still shifts with declination. Overhead Sun only happens between the tropics, and not every day.
misconceptions.zh: 赤道日长接近 12 小时，但正午高度仍随赤纬变化。太阳直射只在两回归线之间出现，而且不是各地每天都有。

objective.key: State that Earth rotates west to east, that 15° of longitude is one hour, and that time zones are a consequence of rotation, not the cause of day and night.
objective.zh: 理解地球自西向东自转，经度相差 15° 对应一小时；时区源于自转，并不是昼夜产生的原因。

why.key: Jet lag is a body clock arguing with a spinning planet. A Leeds frost at 07:00 is already sunlight on a Berlin school roof. The Sun did not jump. Earth turned west to east. Greenwich marks a meridian, not a magic lamp. New York is five school hours behind London because of longitude, not because the Sun prefers the Hudson. Time zones are labels we printed on that spin. They do not cause day and night. A GCSE map that treats the International Date Line as a weather machine has already failed this lab. Fieldwork on a Holderness beach at dawn is the same geometry as a Miami sunrise: we rotated into the beam.
why.zh: 地球自西向东转动，使各地依次进入白昼。经度影响当地太阳时，时区则是人为规定的民用时间；时区本身不会造成昼夜。格林尼治只是经度参考线。

why.key: Earth rotates west to east. We face the Sun, then we face away. One hour is about 15° of longitude. In a Sun-fixed view the terminator stays approximately fixed while Earth turns beneath it; relative to the ground, daylight moves westwards. What moves: which meridians are in the beam. What does not: the Sun’s place as the lamp, the fact of a hard terminator. What is conserved: 360° in about 24 hours relative to the Sun, 15° per school hour. Sidereal day is about 23 h 56 min; solar day is 24 h. Equation of time is a sundial footnote, not the plot. Time-zone bands follow the spin as a political overlay. They kink for borders. They do not drive the terminator. Night side is kept dark on purpose so the lesson reads from the back row. The lie the model tells: rotation is sped up so a day fits a lesson. Shape is a true sphere. The Sun is not circling us each day.
why.zh: 从太阳方向固定的视角看，晨昏线近似保持不动，地球在其下转动；相对于地面，白昼向西推进。一个平均太阳日约 24 小时，对应每小时约 15°；恒星日约 23 小时 56 分钟。实际视太阳时还受时差方程影响。

why.key: Play a day. Freeze the terminator over the Atlantic and ask who is in daylight: London or New York. Advance one hour. Count 15° of longitude. Overlay time zones, then take them off. Keyboard: Space play, arrows scrub the hour, L labels, R reset, P projector. Toggle time-zone bands. Pause. Ask what ‘the Sun rises’ actually means before you name rotation. Reset if the class has lost Greenwich.
why.zh: 将晨昏线停在大西洋，判断伦敦和纽约谁在白昼。前进一小时，比较约 15° 的转动，再开关时区带。空格播放，方向键调时间，L 标签，R 重置，P 投影。

why.key: The globe is a sphere of true shape. Rotation rate is sped up so a day fits a lesson. Night side is kept dark on purpose. Without the 3D view keep the sentences. Earth rotates west to east. One hour is 15° of longitude. Time zones are labels, not machinery. Dawn is the planet turning into the beam. The Sun is not circling us each day. Greenwich is a meridian. That is enough for Check on paper, and enough to kill a ‘Sun goes round us’ sentence in one line.
why.zh: 球体形状保持真实，转速为课堂加快，夜面压暗以突出晨昏线。即使没有三维视图，也可用球体与光源说明：地球自西向东转，转向太阳时进入白昼，转离时进入黑夜。

steps.key: Watch Earth turn west to east, carrying places into daylight and then darkness. Compare London, Cairo, Nairobi and Sydney.
steps.zh: 观察地球自西向东转动，使不同地点依次进入白昼和黑夜。比较伦敦、开罗、内罗毕与悉尼的受光情况。

steps.key: Pause and drag the hour slider. One hour is 15° of longitude. Toggle the time-zone bands. They follow the spin; they do not cause it.
steps.zh: 暂停并拖动小时滑块。每小时约对应 15° 经度；显示或隐藏时区带，区分地球自转与人为规定的时区。

steps.key: Earth rotates once in about 23 h 56 min relative to the stars (sidereal), 24 h relative to the Sun. We face the Sun, then we face away. The Sun is not circling us each day.
steps.zh: 相对恒星的一周自转约为 23 小时 56 分钟，相对太阳的一天约为 24 小时。昼夜来自地球转动，并非太阳每天绕地球一周。

steps.key: 4 questions with explanations. Give a reason for each choice; there is no score gate.
steps.zh: 4 道题，附解析。请说明选择理由。

script.key:
Freeze the globe with the terminator over the Atlantic.
Ask who is in daylight: London or New York? Wait for the room.
Advance one hour. Count 15° of longitude.
Overlay time zones. Take them off again.
Time zones are labels, not machinery. The planet turns west to east.
Ask what ‘the Sun rises’ actually means. We rotated into the beam.
Mention equation of time once: 15° is a school hour, not a sundial hour.
Night is dark on purpose so the terminator reads from the back row.
Space plays a day. Arrows scrub. P projector.
Finish in Check.
script.zh:
观察地球自西向东转动，使不同地点依次进入白昼和黑夜。比较伦敦、开罗、内罗毕与悉尼的受光情况。
暂停并拖动小时滑块。每小时约对应 15° 经度；显示或隐藏时区带，区分地球自转与人为规定的时区。
相对恒星的一周自转约为 23 小时 56 分钟，相对太阳的一天约为 24 小时。昼夜来自地球转动，并非太阳每天绕地球一周。
最后完成自测，请学生说明判断依据。

pitfalls.key: Globe animations that rotate the wrong way (east to west).
pitfalls.zh: 确认自转方向为自西向东。

pitfalls.key: Calling 24 h the sidereal day.
pitfalls.zh: 不要把 24 小时称为恒星日。

misconceptions.key: The Sun moves around Earth once a day.
misconceptions.zh: 太阳每天绕地球一周。

misconceptions.key: Earth rotates west to east. The Sun only appears to move.
misconceptions.zh: 地球自西向东转动，产生太阳每天移动的视运动。

misconceptions.key: Time zones cause day and night.
misconceptions.zh: 时区造成昼夜。

misconceptions.key: Zones are civil labels on meridians. Day and night are which face of the planet sees the Sun.
misconceptions.zh: 时区是民用时间规则；昼夜取决于地球哪一面朝向太阳。

misconceptions.key: A 24-hour day is the time Earth takes to face the same star again.
misconceptions.zh: 24 小时是地球重新朝向同一恒星的时间。

misconceptions.key: That is the sidereal day, about 23 h 56 min. The solar day is 24 h because Earth has also moved along its orbit.
misconceptions.zh: 恒星日约 23 小时 56 分钟；由于地球同时公转，平均太阳日约为 24 小时。

objective.key: Link each phase to the Moon’s position around Earth, distinguish the synodic month from a single night, and show why eclipses are rare.
objective.zh: 把月相与月球绕地位置联系起来，区分朔望月和一夜内的变化，并解释日月食为何不常发生。

why.key: Tides, festivals, and a Snowdonia night walk all run on the same Sun–Earth–Moon triangle. A full Moon over Yosemite is geometry, not a mood. Lunar calendars count phases. Eclipse chasers wait for node crossings, not for every full Moon. A first-quarter Moon is high over Leeds in the afternoon; that surprises a class that thinks the Moon is a night-only lamp. The same triangle lights a Holderness tide table and a California eclipse map. If you teach Earth’s shadow as the crescent, every later eclipse lesson has to unteach it.
why.zh: 月历、潮汐和日月食都与日—地—月几何有关。月球并非只在夜间出现，上弦月在下午也可见。理解月相的观测角度，才能与月食区分。

why.key: The Moon is a ball half-lit by the Sun. What we call a phase is how much of that sunlit half faces Earth. New, first quarter, full, last quarter are four camera angles on one sphere. A crescent is not Earth’s shadow — that is a lunar eclipse, and it needs alignment. What moves: the Moon’s place around Earth, and therefore the viewing angle. What does not: the fact that half the Moon is always sunlit. What is conserved: the Sun as the lamp, the Moon as a sphere. The Moon’s orbit is tilted about 5° to the ecliptic, so most months it misses Earth’s shadow. Size here is exaggerated so the set reads from the back of the room; the real Moon is about 30 Earth-diameters away. Synodic month, new to new, is about 29.53 days, longer than the sidereal month because Earth has moved. The lamp-and-ball demo that parks the Moon in Earth’s shadow for a crescent is the wrong machine.
why.zh: 通常月球一半被太阳照亮；月相取决于地球能看见这部分的多少。月食例外，需要月球进入地球影子。月球轨道相对黄道约倾斜 5°，因此多数满月错过影子。真实地月距离约为 30 个地球直径；本视图为观察而放大天体。新月到新月约 29.53 天，因为地球同时公转，长于恒星月。

why.key: Freeze at new, first quarter, full, last quarter. For each, ask the class to sketch the triangle before you rotate the view. Toggle eclipse alignment — the 5° tilt going to zero — and ask why next month’s full Moon will not be an eclipse. Keyboard: Space play, arrows through the month, L labels, R reset, P projector. Turn alignment on once, then off. Size is the labelled lie. Geometry is the plot.
why.zh: 分别停在新月、上弦、满月和下弦，请学生先画出三者位置，再旋转视角核对。短暂将轨道调整到食的对齐状态，随后恢复约 5° 倾角，解释为何并非每次满月都发生月食。

why.key: Without the 3D view: half the Moon is always sunlit; phases are the viewing angle from Earth; eclipses need the Moon near a node of its tilted orbit. The lamp-and-ball demo that puts the Moon in Earth’s shadow for a crescent is the wrong machine. New Moon sits between us and the Sun. Full Moon sits opposite. First quarter is a right angle. A synodic month is new to new, about 29.5 days. That is enough for Check, and enough to refuse ‘the crescent is Earth’s shadow’.
why.zh: 不用三维模型时，可用灯和球演示：新月大致位于日地之间，满月位于地球背向太阳的一侧，上弦时两者方向约成直角。月牙来自受光部分的可见角度，不要把球放进地球影子来模拟普通月相。

steps.key: Play a synodic month. Watch the lit half of the Moon always face the Sun, while the face we see from Earth changes.
steps.zh: 播放一个朔望月。月球被照亮的一半始终朝向太阳，而地球上看到的明亮部分不断变化。

steps.key: Pause at first quarter and full. Toggle the Earth-view disc. Then turn on eclipse alignment: the 5° orbital tilt is why most months have no eclipse.
steps.zh: 在上弦和满月时暂停，比较地球视角的月面。显示食的几何关系，解释约 5° 轨道倾角为何使日月食不是每月发生。

steps.key: Phases are geometry, not Earth’s shadow (except during a lunar eclipse). New Moon is between us and the Sun; full Moon is opposite.
steps.zh: 月相主要由观测几何决定，并非地球影子造成。新月时月球大致位于日地之间，满月时位于地球背向太阳的一侧。

steps.key: 4 questions with explanations. Give a reason for each choice; there is no score gate.
steps.zh: 4 道题，附解析。请说明选择理由。

script.key:
Freeze at new Moon. Sketch the Sun–Earth–Moon triangle on the board.
First quarter. Full. Last quarter. Same sketch, different angle.
Ask why the dark of the Moon is not Earth’s shadow. Wait before you reveal.
Enable the 5° tilt. Ask why next month’s full Moon is not an eclipse.
Turn eclipse alignment on once, then off.
Size is exaggerated so the geometry reads from the back row.
A first-quarter Moon can be high in the afternoon. Say that.
Space plays the month. Arrows scrub. P projector.
Finish in Check.
script.zh:
播放一个朔望月。月球被照亮的一半始终朝向太阳，而地球上看到的明亮部分不断变化。
在上弦和满月时暂停，比较地球视角的月面。显示食的几何关系，解释约 5° 轨道倾角为何使日月食不是每月发生。
月相主要由观测几何决定，并非地球影子造成。新月时月球大致位于日地之间，满月时位于地球背向太阳的一侧。
最后完成自测，请学生说明判断依据。

pitfalls.key: Ball-and-lamp demos that put the Moon in Earth’s shadow for a crescent.
pitfalls.zh: 灯球演示中，不要用地球影子解释普通月牙。

pitfalls.key: Scale: the Moon is 30 Earth-diameters away. This lab exaggerates size so the geometry reads from the back of the room.
pitfalls.zh: 真实地月距离约为 30 个地球直径；本实验放大了天体。

misconceptions.key: The crescent is Earth’s shadow on the Moon.
misconceptions.zh: 月牙是地球影子落在月球上。

misconceptions.key: The crescent is the Moon’s night side. Earth’s shadow is an eclipse.
misconceptions.zh: 月牙形状来自月球自身受光面与夜面的可见比例；地球影子造成的是月食。

misconceptions.key: The Moon is only in the sky at night, and only when it is full.
misconceptions.zh: 月球只在夜间、而且只有满月时出现。

misconceptions.key: A first-quarter Moon is high in the afternoon. Phase is a viewing angle, not a schedule of appearance.
misconceptions.zh: 上弦月在下午也可高悬天空。月相由几何决定，不等同于可见时段。

misconceptions.key: Every full Moon is a lunar eclipse.
misconceptions.zh: 每次满月都是月食。

misconceptions.key: The Moon’s orbit is tilted about 5°. Full happens every month; an eclipse needs the Moon near a node.
misconceptions.zh: 月球轨道倾斜约 5°；月食还需要月球靠近轨道交点。

objective.key: Name the four main layers, their state, and why a liquid outer core plus P/S-wave shadows tell us the inside is not uniform rock.
objective.zh: 辨认地球的四个主要圈层及其物态，并用液态外核与 P、S 波影区解释内部结构。

why.key: Earth’s radius is approximately 6371 km. This section uses a uniform 35 km reference crust, a core–mantle boundary at radius 3480 km and an inner-core radius of 1221 km. Oceanic crust is commonly 5–10 km thick and continental crust commonly 30–50 km; real boundaries are not perfectly concentric spheres.
why.zh: 地球半径约 6,371 km。本剖面采用均匀 35 km 参考地壳、半径 3,480 km 的核幔边界及半径 1,221 km 的内核。洋壳常厚 5–10 km，大陆地壳常厚 30–50 km；真实边界并非完美同心球。

why.key: The mantle is overwhelmingly solid silicate rock that deforms over geological time. Local partial melting does not make it a global magma ocean. The outer core is liquid iron-rich alloy; the inner core is solid. Material colours and textures distinguish these layers and are not photographs of inaccessible depths.
why.zh: 地幔主要是固态硅酸盐岩石，在地质时间尺度上缓慢变形；局部部分熔融不等于全球岩浆海。外核为富铁液态合金，内核为固态。颜色和材质帮助辨认，并非不可到达深处的照片。

why.key: Slice opens a longitudinal wedge with closed section faces. Explode separates the shells for inspection; restore spacing before comparing depths or wave paths. The default crust is four times the reference thickness. T restores all boundary radii to one geometric scale, where the crust is very thin.
why.zh: 切片移去一个纵向楔体，露出闭合剖面。分离功能便于观察各壳层；比较深度和波路前应恢复间距。默认地壳厚度放大四倍，T 恢复共同长度比例，此时地壳很薄。

why.key: Enable P/S waves and press Play. Blue illustrates compression transmitted through solids and liquid; amber illustrates shear ending at the outer core. The lines do not solve variable seismic velocities, refraction, conversions or observed shadow zones. Real seismic observations, Earth’s bulk properties and other evidence constrain its interior; these illustrative paths demonstrate only the contrast in material transmission.
why.zh: 开启 P／S 波后播放：蓝色表示压缩可通过固体和液体，琥珀色表示剪切在外核处停止。这些路径不计算变速传播、折射、波型转换或实测阴影区。地震观测、总体物理性质等共同约束内部结构，本动画仅说明物态导致的传播差异。

steps.key: Rotate the cutaway, then change Slice and Explode. Identify the four layers and read their material states.
steps.zh: 旋转剖面，改变切片和分离距离。辨认四个圈层，并读出各层的物态。

steps.key: Restore unexploded spacing, then enable P/S waves. Compare transmission through solid mantle and liquid outer core.
steps.zh: 恢复未分离状态，开启 P／S 波。比较固态地幔与液态外核中的传播差异。

steps.key: Use T to restore the 35 km reference crust. Explain what seismology can reveal and what these illustrative paths cannot calculate.
steps.zh: 按 T 恢复 35 km 参考地壳的真实比例。说明地震波能揭示什么，以及这些示意路径没有计算什么。

steps.key: 4 questions with explanations. Give a reason for each choice; there is no score gate.
steps.zh: 4 道题，附解析。请说明选择理由。

script.key:
Open the wedge and identify crust, mantle, outer core and inner core.
Ask which layer is liquid, then read the labels.
Use Explode to inspect the shells; return it to zero before comparing depths.
Press T and compare the thin reference crust with its fourfold teaching enlargement.
Enable P/S waves and play. Describe transmission, then state that these paths do not calculate refraction or shadow zones.
Compare the mantle xenolith photograph with the model’s mostly solid mantle.
Finish in Check.
script.zh:
旋转剖面，改变切片和分离距离。辨认四个圈层，并读出各层的物态。
恢复未分离状态，开启 P／S 波。比较固态地幔与液态外核中的传播差异。
按 T 恢复 35 km 参考地壳的真实比例。说明地震波能揭示什么，以及这些示意路径没有计算什么。
最后完成自测，请学生说明判断依据。

pitfalls.key: Calling the mantle a magma ocean.
pitfalls.zh: 不要将地幔称为岩浆海。

pitfalls.key: Treating the illustrative straight paths as a calculation of seismic shadow zones.
pitfalls.zh: 直线波路并非地震阴影区计算。

pitfalls.key: Comparing depths while layers are exploded.
pitfalls.zh: 比较深度前应关闭圈层分离。

misconceptions.key: The mantle is a sea of molten lava.
misconceptions.zh: 地幔是一片熔岩海。

misconceptions.key: The mantle is overwhelmingly solid. Magma is a local, partial melt. The liquid layer is the outer core, and it is metal, not lava.
misconceptions.zh: 地幔绝大部分为固态，岩浆通常是局部部分熔融。液态外核主要是金属，并非熔岩。

misconceptions.key: We have samples from the core, like we have Moon rocks.
misconceptions.zh: 我们已像采集月岩一样取得地核样品。

misconceptions.key: We have not. The deepest borehole is crust. Core composition is inferred from seismology, density, and meteorite chemistry.
misconceptions.zh: 尚未取得地核样品。最深钻孔仍在地壳内；地核性质由地震学、密度及陨石化学等约束。

misconceptions.key: The crust is a thick layer you could walk around inside.
misconceptions.zh: 地壳是球体内部很厚的一大层。

misconceptions.key: Continental crust averages about 35 km on a 6371 km radius. This lab draws it ×4 so you can see it. It is a film.
misconceptions.zh: 参考大陆地壳 35 km 相对于地球 6,371 km 半径很薄。实验默认放大四倍便于观察。

objective.key: Distinguish divergent, convergent and transform boundaries, name a landform for each, and compare reconstructed continental positions through time.
objective.zh: 区分离散、汇聚和转换边界，辨认相应地貌，并比较不同时期重建的大陆位置。

why.key: The Mid-Atlantic Ridge makes oceanic crust. At Cascadia, oceanic lithosphere descends beneath North America. Along the San Andreas Fault, plates slide past one another. These boundary processes differ from coastal erosion at Holderness, which lies within the Eurasian plate.
why.zh: 大西洋中脊形成新洋壳，卡斯卡迪亚的大洋岩石圈向北美下方俯冲，圣安德烈斯断层则以水平错动为主。这些板块过程不同于欧亚板块内部霍尔德内斯的海岸侵蚀。

why.key: Divergence separates plates; convergence brings them together; transform motion is mainly lateral. Oceanic subduction and continental collision are different convergent settings. Plates and their boundaries evolve through time. The globe uses Bird PB2002 present-day boundaries; the past uses GPlates MULLER2019 coastlines reconstructed in a mantle reference frame. Present-day shorelines are carried backwards to illustrate continental positions; they are not mapped ancient sea levels.
why.zh: 离散使板块分开，汇聚使板块靠近，转换以侧向错动为主。大洋俯冲与大陆碰撞是不同汇聚环境。现代边界采用 Bird PB2002；历史大陆位置采用地幔参考系下 GPlates MULLER2019 重建。现代岸线随板块向过去移动，不代表当时的海平面或古海岸。

why.key: Use the time slider for discrete 10 Ma snapshots. Modern boundaries are shown only at 0 Ma. Switch to Boundary section and choose a named type to compare the motion arrows. Hawaii marks a present-day hotspot location, not a plate boundary. Use the separate Hotspots lab to explore the age track.
why.zh: 时间滑块采用离散的 10 Ma 快照，现代边界只在 0 Ma 显示。切到边界剖面、选择类型并比较箭头。夏威夷标记的是现代热点位置，不是板块边界；年龄轨迹见热点实验。

why.key: If 3D is unavailable, use the photographs and the World map studio. Explain three relative motions, then match a ridge, a trench or a strike-slip fault to each. Finish in Check.
why.zh: 三维视图不可用时，可结合照片和世界地图工作室。解释三种相对运动，并分别对应洋中脊、海沟或走滑断层，再完成自测。

steps.key: Rotate the present-day globe. Teal marks divergent boundaries, coral convergent boundaries, and sand transform boundaries. Switch to Boundary section to compare their motion.
steps.zh: 旋转现代地球：青绿色为离散边界，珊瑚色为汇聚边界，沙色为转换边界。切到边界剖面，比较运动。

steps.key: Scrub the globe back towards Pangaea using 10 Ma GPlates snapshots. These are modern coastlines carried by a plate-motion model, not ancient shorelines. Return to 0 Ma to locate Hawaii.
steps.zh: 用每隔 10 Ma 的 GPlates 重建快照回到盘古大陆时期。这是现代海岸线随板块模型移动，并非古海岸线。回到 0 Ma 寻找夏威夷。

steps.key: Divergent: plates apart, new crust, ridges and rift valleys. Convergent: together, trenches or collision mountains. Transform: slide, earthquakes without a volcano chain.
steps.zh: 离散边界张开并形成新洋壳；汇聚边界产生俯冲或碰撞山系；转换边界水平错动，常有地震但通常不形成火山链。

steps.key: 4 questions with explanations. Give a reason for each choice; there is no score gate.
steps.zh: 4 道题，附解析。请说明选择理由。

script.key:
Name the three colours before any place names.
Point at Iceland, Himalaya, San Andreas. Wait for the class to assign types.
Arrows along plate motion, not at the line.
Scrub toward Pangaea. The UK sits on Eurasia; it is not a plate.
Hawaii on. Ask which way the Pacific plate is going from the age chain.
Three jobs: diverge, converge, slide. Not three moods.
Holderness loses till; Himalaya gain rock. Same machine, different edges.
Space, arrows, L, P. Then Check.
script.zh:
旋转现代地球：青绿色为离散边界，珊瑚色为汇聚边界，沙色为转换边界。切到边界剖面，比较运动。
用每隔 10 Ma 的 GPlates 重建快照回到盘古大陆时期。这是现代海岸线随板块模型移动，并非古海岸线。回到 0 Ma 寻找夏威夷。
离散边界张开并形成新洋壳；汇聚边界产生俯冲或碰撞山系；转换边界水平错动，常有地震但通常不形成火山链。
最后完成自测，请学生说明判断依据。

pitfalls.key: Calling the UK a plate. It sits on the Eurasian plate.
pitfalls.zh: 英国位于欧亚板块上，不是独立板块。

pitfalls.key: Drawing arrows that point at the boundary instead of along plate motion.
pitfalls.zh: 箭头应沿相对运动方向，不能一律指向边界。

misconceptions.key: Continents plough through a static ocean floor.
misconceptions.zh: 大陆穿过静止不动的海底。

misconceptions.key: Continents are passengers on plates. Ocean floor is also plate, created at ridges and destroyed at trenches.
misconceptions.zh: 大陆和海底都是板块的一部分；海底可在洋中脊形成、在俯冲带被消耗。

misconceptions.key: The UK is its own plate.
misconceptions.zh: 英国单独构成一个板块。

misconceptions.key: The UK sits on the Eurasian plate. Iceland sits on the Mid-Atlantic Ridge, a divergent boundary.
misconceptions.zh: 英国位于欧亚板块上；冰岛位于大西洋中脊这一离散边界。

misconceptions.key: All volcanoes sit on plate edges.
misconceptions.zh: 所有火山都位于板块边缘。

misconceptions.key: Most do. Hawaii is a hotspot punching through a plate interior. The age chain records plate motion.
misconceptions.zh: 许多火山与边界有关，但夏威夷等热点位于板块内部，年龄链可记录相对板块运动。

objective.key: Read contour lines as a 3D surface, tell spur from valley, and drop a spot height that matches the 3D hill.
objective.zh: 把等高线读成三维地形，区分山嘴与谷地，并标出与地形一致的高程点。

why.key: A GCSE map question is a hill wearing a disguise. The spur and the valley are the same lines, bending opposite ways. Walk a contour on Snowdonia and you neither climb nor descend. Yosemite’s valley walls pack the lines; the floor opens them. OS 1:25 000 and USGS quads both hide the hill in the interval. If a student counts lines instead of intervals they will misread every height question. North is not up the slope.
why.zh: 等高线将山地的高度压缩进地图。谷壁陡处线条密集，谷底平缓处疏开。读高差应数间隔，不是数线条；地图北方也不等于上坡方向。

why.key: A contour joins equal height. Walk it and you neither climb nor descend. Packed lines: steep. Open lines: gentle. A V pointing upslope is a valley; a V pointing downslope is a spur. What moves in this lab: the interval slider, the 2D/3D flip. What does not: the hill. What is conserved: height along a line. Interval is the step between lines, not the line count. Spot heights and trig points are extras. The hill is a schematic contour model, not a traced OS sheet. Vertical scale is readable, not a 1:1 mountain. The lie is the pretty slope; the skill is reading the disguise. Flip 2D to 3D and the same V must still be a valley.
why.zh: 等高线连接等高位置。谷地的 V 形朝向上游，山脊的 V 形朝下坡。改变等高距或切换二维／三维时，地形本身不变。本实验由同一表面计算等高线顶点，不是临摹实地地图。

why.key: Start in 2D. Ask spur or valley on the marked V. Flip to 3D without telling them. Change interval from 5 m to 20 m and ask what disappeared. Keyboard: L labels, R reset, P projector. Students count intervals, not lines. North is not ‘up the slope’. Reset view if the hill has been orbited into a puzzle.
why.zh: 先在二维图辨认山脊和谷地，再切三维核对。把等高距从 5 m 调到 20 m，观察消失的是中间线条，而非地形。L 切换标签，R 重置，P 投影。

why.key: The hill is a schematic contour model, not a traced OS sheet. Vertical scale is readable, not a 1:1 mountain. Without the 3D view: packed lines are steep, open lines are gentle, a V pointing upslope is a valley, a spur bends the other way. Count intervals, not lines. North is a grid, not the slope. That is enough for Check, and enough to sit an OS extract without the 3D crutch.
why.zh: 默认起伏放大 2.5 倍，T 恢复横纵相同比例，此时 1 场景单位为 100 m。没有三维视图时，仍可用线条疏密、V 形朝向及等高距判断地形。

steps.key: Toggle 2D map and 3D hill. Same land. The V of the contours points up-valley; the spur’s V points downslope.
steps.zh: 切换二维地图与三维山地，观察同一地形。谷地等高线的 V 形指向上游，山脊的 V 形指向下坡。

steps.key: Change the contour interval. Drop a spot height. Tight lines are steep. Wide lines are gentle.
steps.zh: 改变等高距并添加高程点。等高线越密通常越陡，越疏通常越缓。

steps.key: A contour is a line of equal height. Walk it and you neither climb nor descend. The knoll is a closed loop; the col is the saddle between two knolls.
steps.zh: 沿同一等高线行走，高度不变。辨认闭合的小丘圈线及两丘之间的鞍部。

steps.key: 4 questions with explanations. Give a reason for each choice; there is no score gate.
steps.zh: 4 道题，附解析。请说明选择理由。

script.key:
Start in 2D. Ask spur or valley on the marked V. Wait.
Flip to 3D without telling them. The hill should match the map.
Change interval from 5 m to 20 m. Ask what disappeared.
Students count intervals, not lines.
North is not ‘up the slope’.
Packed lines are steep. Open lines are gentle.
This is a schematic hill, not a traced OS sheet. Say so.
L labels. R reset. P projector.
Finish in Check.
script.zh:
切换二维地图与三维山地，观察同一地形。谷地等高线的 V 形指向上游，山脊的 V 形指向下坡。
改变等高距并添加高程点。等高线越密通常越陡，越疏通常越缓。
沿同一等高线行走，高度不变。辨认闭合的小丘圈线及两丘之间的鞍部。
最后完成自测，请学生说明判断依据。

pitfalls.key: Students counting lines instead of intervals.
pitfalls.zh: 让学生数间隔，不是数线条。

pitfalls.key: Assuming north is always ‘up the slope’.
pitfalls.zh: 不要把地图北方当成上坡。

misconceptions.key: Contours are paths.
misconceptions.zh: 等高线就是道路。

misconceptions.key: They are height. A path may follow a contour, but the line itself is not a trail.
misconceptions.zh: 它表示高度；道路可以沿等高线走，但线条本身不代表路径。

misconceptions.key: The V of a contour always points downhill.
misconceptions.zh: 等高线的 V 形总是朝下坡。

misconceptions.key: Valley Vs point uphill (upstream). Spur Vs point downhill. Same ink, opposite jobs.
misconceptions.zh: 谷地 V 形朝上游，山脊 V 形朝下坡，两者相反。

misconceptions.key: You count the brown lines to get the height change.
misconceptions.zh: 数出棕色线条数量就能计算高差。

misconceptions.key: Count the intervals (gaps) and multiply by the contour interval. Five gaps at 10 m is 50 m.
misconceptions.zh: 应数间隔并乘以等高距。例如五个间隔、每隔 10 m，高差为 50 m。

objective.key: Follow a river from source to mouth, compare downstream gradients and bends, and distinguish discharge from stage.
objective.zh: 沿河源走向河口，比较纵坡与河弯，并区分流量和水位。

why.key: A long profile follows a river’s bed from source towards its base level. Many rivers become less steep downstream, but geology, uplift, tributaries and dams can interrupt this general pattern. Upper, middle and lower course describe parts of one connected system.
why.zh: 河流纵剖面表示从源头朝基准面的河床高程。许多河流向下游逐渐变缓，但地质、抬升、支流和大坝可打断这一趋势。上、中、下游属于同一个连续系统。

why.key: The model has a concave long profile, downstream bends and a broader lower-course floodplain. Inside bends have gentler gravel margins; outside bends have steeper banks. Water moves through a fixed channel: increasing the relative discharge raises the displayed stage, and the wet edges follow its intersection with the bed. This is an illustrative stage response, not a calculated rating curve, velocity, sediment competence or flood boundary.
why.zh: 模型具有凹形纵剖面、下游弯道及较宽洪泛平原。内岸砾石边缘较缓，外岸较陡。水在固定河道中流动；提高相对流量会抬高显示水位，湿润边缘由水面与河床相交确定。这不是流量—水位关系曲线、流速、搬运能力或洪水范围计算。

why.key: Hide the labels and identify steeper and gentler reaches. Play follows tracers downstream; the time control does not erode this landscape. Raise Discharge and compare water level. T removes the twelvefold vertical exaggeration. Use River erosion and River deposition for landform development, and Storm hydrograph for a calculated discharge response.
why.zh: 隐藏标签辨认陡缓河段。播放只使标记向下游运动，不侵蚀地形。提高流量比较水位，按 T 去除十二倍垂直夸张。地貌发展见侵蚀与沉积实验，计算的流量响应见暴雨过程线。

why.key: This is a conceptual long profile, not a survey or forecast. Channel breadth, trees and bank clasts are enlarged to remain visible across the whole profile, including in the equal-relief view. The mixed woodland illustrates one temperate catchment, not every river habitat. Waterfalls, oxbow cut-offs and deltas do not occur on every river. Use the real Ucayali photograph to identify active bends and abandoned channels, then explain how it differs from this model.
why.zh: 这是概念纵剖面，不是测绘或预报。河宽、树木和砾石在真实起伏视图中仍适当放大；混合林代表一种温带环境，并非所有河流。瀑布、牛轭湖和三角洲也不是每条河都有。用乌卡亚利河实景辨认活动弯道和废弃河道，再与模型比较。

steps.key: Follow the bed from the steeper upper reach through bends to the gentler lower reach. These are parts of one river.
steps.zh: 沿河床从较陡的上游走向弯曲河段及较缓的下游；这些都是同一河流的不同部分。

steps.key: Raise Discharge and compare stage and wetted margins. Play follows water downstream without eroding the fixed channel.
steps.zh: 提高流量，比较水位和被水覆盖的河岸。动画只追踪向下游的流动，不侵蚀固定河道。

steps.key: Press T to remove vertical exaggeration. Compare the Ucayali photograph with this conceptual channel; use the separate erosion and deposition labs for those processes.
steps.zh: 按 T 去除垂直夸张。将乌卡亚利河照片与概念河道比较，再到河流侵蚀和沉积实验探索相关过程。

steps.key: 4 questions with explanations. Give a reason for each choice; there is no score gate.
steps.zh: 4 道题，附解析。请说明选择理由。

script.key:
Trace the bed from source to mouth with labels hidden.
Compare upstream and downstream gradients.
Raise Discharge; distinguish stage, width and discharge. The response is qualitative.
Press T to remove vertical exaggeration.
Use the Ucayali photograph to identify abandoned bends, then open River erosion for that process.
Finish in Check.
script.zh:
沿河床从较陡的上游走向弯曲河段及较缓的下游；这些都是同一河流的不同部分。
提高流量，比较水位和被水覆盖的河岸。动画只追踪向下游的流动，不侵蚀固定河道。
按 T 去除垂直夸张。将乌卡亚利河照片与概念河道比较，再到河流侵蚀和沉积实验探索相关过程。
最后完成自测，请学生说明判断依据。

pitfalls.key: Teaching the upper/middle/lower courses as three different rivers.
pitfalls.zh: 把上、中、下游作为同一条河来讲。

pitfalls.key: Forgetting that UK ‘deltas’ are often estuaries because of tides.
pitfalls.zh: 区分三角洲与受潮汐影响的河口湾。

misconceptions.key: Rivers always take the shortest path to the sea.
misconceptions.zh: 河流总走最短路径入海。

misconceptions.key: They meander on low gradients. The shortest path is a cutoff after a flood, not the default.
misconceptions.zh: 缓坡河流可曲折流动；截弯可形成较短新水路，并非所有河道始终最短。

misconceptions.key: Upper, middle and lower course are three different rivers.
misconceptions.zh: 上、中、下游是三条不同河流。

misconceptions.key: They are stations on one long profile. Energy and load change downstream.
misconceptions.zh: 它们是同一纵剖面上的河段，能量与搬运物质可沿程变化。

misconceptions.key: Every UK river ends in a delta like the Mississippi.
misconceptions.zh: 每条英国河流都像密西西比河一样形成三角洲。

misconceptions.key: Many UK mouths are estuaries because of tides. A classic delta needs a large load and modest tidal range.
misconceptions.zh: 许多英国河口受潮汐影响而形成河口湾。沉积物供应、波浪、潮汐及海平面历史共同影响河口类型。

objective.key: Name the main stores and transfers, read a drainage-basin overlay, and see how human abstraction lowers a reservoir.
objective.zh: 辨认主要水储库和输送过程，读取流域叠加图，并观察人类取水如何降低水库储量。

why.key: Name a store before following a transfer. Ocean water, snow and ice, soil moisture, groundwater, vegetation, lakes and atmospheric water are stores. Rivers also hold water, although their global volume is small and their transfer role is prominent.
why.zh: 先识别水库，再追踪转移。海洋、冰雪、土壤水、地下水、植被、湖泊和大气都是储水位置。河流也储水，但全球体积占比很小，其快速输送作用更突出。

why.key: Evaporation and transpiration add vapour to the atmosphere. Cooling can condense it into droplets or ice; precipitation returns water to the surface. Some is intercepted, some infiltrates, and some runs off. Groundwater moves through pores and fractures down a hydraulic-head gradient. The cutaway exposes these stores; it does not imply a hollow underground lake.
why.zh: 蒸发与蒸腾将水汽送入大气；冷却可使其凝结为水滴或冰晶，降水再将水送回地面。部分被植被截留，部分下渗，部分形成径流。地下水沿水头降低方向流过孔隙和裂隙；剖面不表示地下有空心湖泊。

why.key: Choose Follow a transfer to highlight one route while Play moves tracers. Gold dividing ridges enclose the surface catchment; the outlet faces the ocean. Abstraction moves up to 6,000 m³ from an invented 10,000 m³ reservoir into a human-use store. Their combined total stays fixed. Rainfall, return flow and evaporation would be needed for a complete catchment budget.
why.zh: 选择一种转移途径，播放并追踪示踪点。金色分水岭围出地表流域，出口朝向海洋。取水最多将假定水库中 10,000 m³ 的水转移 6,000 m³ 至人类用水库，两者总量不变。完整流域收支还需计算降水、回流和蒸发。

why.key: The terrain and store sizes are conceptual and the arrows are not measured fluxes. Flooding can follow saturated soil, intense rainfall, river overflow or other causes; it is not simply water that cannot infiltrate. Without WebGL, use the observation photograph and explain one store, one input and one output before Check.
why.zh: 地形和储水体积为概念表达，箭头不是实测通量。洪水可由土壤饱和、强降雨、河流漫溢等因素引起，不能只归结为无法下渗。没有三维视图时，可借助照片说明一个水库、一个输入和一个输出。

steps.key: Stores: ocean, atmosphere, ice, groundwater, soil, lakes. Flows: evaporation, transpiration, condensation, precipitation, interception, infiltration, runoff, groundwater flow.
steps.zh: 辨认海洋、大气、冰、地下水、土壤和湖泊等储库，再追踪蒸发、蒸腾、降水、下渗、径流及地下水流。

steps.key: Toggle the drainage-basin overlay. Open the abstraction tap and watch the reservoir fall. The ocean does not notice; the town does.
steps.zh: 显示流域边界并增加取水，观察水库水量减少、人类用水储库增加。

steps.key: Globally the cycle is closed. Locally a basin can be in deficit. Hydrographs (a later skills lab) are this diagram plotted against hours after rain.
steps.zh: 全球水循环近似闭合，局部流域仍可发生亏缺。将水流路径与降雨后的河流响应联系起来。

steps.key: 4 questions with explanations. Give a reason for each choice; there is no score gate.
steps.zh: 4 道题，附解析。请说明选择理由。

script.key:
Name stores first. Ocean, atmosphere, ice, groundwater, soil, lakes.
Chase one particle from ocean to snow to river and back.
Toggle the basin overlay.
Open the abstraction tap. Ask who loses: the ocean or the town.
Rivers are a flow, not a major global store.
A flood is a transfer the soil cannot take.
Stores first, then arrows. That is the misconception to kill.
Space, L, R, P.
Finish in Check.
script.zh:
辨认海洋、大气、冰、地下水、土壤和湖泊等储库，再追踪蒸发、蒸腾、降水、下渗、径流及地下水流。
显示流域边界并增加取水，观察水库水量减少、人类用水储库增加。
全球水循环近似闭合，局部流域仍可发生亏缺。将水流路径与降雨后的河流响应联系起来。
最后完成自测，请学生说明判断依据。

pitfalls.key: Arrow salad with no stores.
pitfalls.zh: 只讲箭头，不指出水储存在何处。

pitfalls.key: Teaching the cycle as if rivers were a major global store.
pitfalls.zh: 误把河流视为全球主要淡水储库。

misconceptions.key: Water is used up.
misconceptions.zh: 水会被彻底用完。

misconceptions.key: The global mass is conserved. Quality, location, and timing change. A dry reservoir is a local budget failure.
misconceptions.zh: 全球水量近似守恒，但水质、位置和时间分布会改变。水库枯竭是局部收支问题。

misconceptions.key: Rivers are a major global store of fresh water.
misconceptions.zh: 河流是全球淡水的主要储库。

misconceptions.key: Ice then groundwater dominate fresh water. Rivers are a fast transfer, a trickle in the budget.
misconceptions.zh: 冰雪和地下水储量远大于河流；河流的快速输送作用更显著。

misconceptions.key: The cycle is a circle of arrows with no stores.
misconceptions.zh: 水循环只是首尾相连的箭头，没有储库。

misconceptions.key: Stores first, then transfers. Abstraction mines a named store. A flood is a transfer the soil cannot take.
misconceptions.zh: 必须先指出储库，再解释转移。取水减少特定储库；洪水则需结合降雨、下渗、汇流与河道条件分析。

objective.key: Relate period to orbital distance, compare mean radii and explain why visible body markers can use a different scale.
objective.zh: 理解公转周期与轨道距离的关系，比较平均半径，并说明为什么可见的天体标记采用了放大比例。

why.key: Mercury, Venus, Earth and Mars are rocky planets. Jupiter and Saturn are gas giants; Uranus and Neptune are ice giants, with substantial atmospheres rather than exposed solid surfaces. The Sun is a star. Planetary rings consist of orbiting particles, not a rigid disc. Mean radii are useful for size comparisons, while the giant planets are noticeably oblate.
why.zh: 水星、金星、地球和火星是岩质行星；木星和土星是气态巨行星，天王星和海王星是冰巨行星，均有厚重大气而非裸露固体表面。太阳是恒星。行星环由绕行粒子构成，不是固体圆盘。平均半径适合比较大小，但巨行星有明显扁率。

why.key: Orbital motion uses JPL J2000 semi-major axes, eccentricities, inclinations and orbital orientations, held fixed. Kepler’s equation makes a planet move faster near perihelion and slower near aphelion. Published orbital periods set the clocks. All eight start at their own perihelion in this chosen experiment, not at their observed positions on a shared date. Perturbations, evolving orbital elements and Earth–Moon barycentre offsets are omitted; this is not a sky-position service.
why.zh: 模型采用 JPL J2000 轨道长半轴、偏心率、倾角和方向并保持不变，以开普勒方程计算近日点加速、远日点减速，公转周期采用公布值。八颗行星各自从近日点出发，并非某个共同日期的真实星位；忽略摄动、轨道要素演变和地月质心偏移。

why.key: Inner orbits resolve the four rocky planets. All eight orbits uses the same AU scale for every orbit without logarithmic compression. Default body markers are enlarged individually for visibility. Press T to make physical radii and orbital distances share one scale; most planets become smaller than a pixel. It is possible to draw both scales correctly, but impossible to resolve all body details on a small screen at once.
why.zh: 内侧轨道视图便于观察四颗岩质行星；八轨道视图统一采用 AU 线性比例。默认天体分别放大以便辨认。T 使半径与轨道距离采用同一比例，多数行星会小于一个像素；课堂屏幕无法同时显示所有真实间距与表面细节。

why.key: Mean-radius comparison uses one size scale with arranged spacing. Selected body close-up compares a planet with Earth at the same radius multiplier. Mercury’s 4096-pixel MESSENGER map uses enhanced colour, not human-eye colour. Jupiter uses a 6000-pixel NASA map; Mars and Saturn use NASA geometry and mapped materials. Venus and the ice giants use explicitly modelled cloud colours, not synthetic photographs or current weather maps. Body orientation and lighting are arranged for inspection, not a dated spin state.
why.zh: 半径对比采用统一大小比例，中心间距经过安排；单体近景与地球使用相同放大倍数。水星 4096 像素 MESSENGER 影像是增强色，木星采用 NASA 6000 像素影像；火星和土星采用 NASA 几何与贴图。金星、天王星和海王星的云色是明确标注的模型材质，并非观测照片。朝向和光照用于展示，不表示指定时刻。

steps.key: Play the inner orbits and compare periods and speed around each ellipse.
steps.zh: 播放内行星公转，比较周期及椭圆轨道上不同位置的速度。

steps.key: Show all eight, then press T to compare physical radii with orbital separation.
steps.zh: 显示八颗行星，再按 T 比较行星半径与轨道间距。

steps.key: Open mean radii or a selected body close-up; name which scale is preserved.
steps.zh: 切换平均半径比较或单一天体近景，说明当前保留的是哪一种比例。

steps.key: 4 questions with explanations. Give a reason for each choice; there is no score gate.
steps.zh: 4 道题，附解析。请说明选择理由。

script.key:
Start with inner orbits and a two-year duration.
Predict which planets complete more revolutions.
Show all eight; press T and explain disappearing discs.
Open mean radii and compare Earth with Jupiter.
Open Saturn close-up and identify the particle rings.
State the chosen starting arrangement and distinguish it from an ephemeris.
Finish in Check.
script.zh:
播放内行星公转，比较周期及椭圆轨道上不同位置的速度。
显示八颗行星，再按 T 比较行星半径与轨道间距。
切换平均半径比较或单一天体近景，说明当前保留的是哪一种比例。
最后完成自测，请学生说明判断依据。

pitfalls.key: Reading display spacing as orbital distance.
pitfalls.zh: 把展示间距当成轨道距离。

pitfalls.key: Describing ring particles as a solid disc.
pitfalls.zh: 把行星环粒子说成固体圆盘。

pitfalls.key: Treating modelled cloud colour as an observation.
pitfalls.zh: 把模拟云色当作观测影像。

misconceptions.key: Planet spacing on a size-comparison board is real distance.
misconceptions.zh: 大小比较图上的行星间距是真实距离。

misconceptions.key: The board preserves mean-radius ratios and deliberately arranges the centres.
misconceptions.zh: 比较图保留平均半径比例，中心位置则经过排布。

misconceptions.key: All planets move at a constant common speed.
misconceptions.zh: 所有行星都以同一个恒定速度运动。

misconceptions.key: Periods differ, and speed changes around each elliptical orbit.
misconceptions.zh: 各行星周期不同，沿椭圆轨道的速度也会改变。

misconceptions.key: The starting arrangement is the sky today.
misconceptions.zh: 初始排列就是今天的天空。

misconceptions.key: Each planet begins at its own perihelion in a reproducible ideal experiment.
misconceptions.zh: 本实验将各行星分别放在近日点，构成可复现的理想初始条件。

objective.key: Compare local-noon and daily-mean solar input by latitude and declination, using a fixed 1 AU reference.
objective.zh: 以固定 1 AU 距离为基准，比较不同纬度与太阳赤纬下的正午和日平均太阳辐射输入。

why.key: Total solar irradiance is power per unit area on a surface perpendicular to the solar beam. The fixed reference here is 1361 W/m² at 1 AU, near the top of Earth’s atmosphere. It is not a measured playground flux, and real irradiance varies slightly with solar activity and Earth–Sun distance.
why.zh: 太阳总辐照度表示垂直于太阳光束的单位面积所接收的功率。这里在 1 AU、大气层顶附近固定采用 1361 W/m²；它不是操场实测值。真实辐照度随太阳活动和日地距离略有变化。

why.key: For a horizontal surface at local noon, the geometric input is 1361 × max(0, cos(latitude − solar declination)). Declination moves the subsolar latitude between about 23.44° south and north over a year. The globe, surface normal, terminator and readout use the same selected declination. Incoming rays are parallel at Earth’s scale.
why.zh: 正午水平面的几何入射量为 1361 × max(0, cos(纬度 − 太阳赤纬))。赤纬使直射纬度在约南北 23.44° 之间移动。球体、表面法线、晨昏线和读数使用同一个赤纬；地球尺度上太阳光线近似平行。

why.key: Daily mean input integrates the cosine through the full rotation, including night. The bars compare this value at seven latitudes. Polar day and night are included; in polar summer a pole can have a high daily mean despite a relatively low solar elevation. The global area-weighted mean is one quarter of beam-normal irradiance before reflection or atmospheric effects.
why.zh: 日平均入射量将余弦关系在完整一天中积分，包含黑夜。柱形图比较七个纬度，并处理极昼极夜；夏季极点虽太阳较低，连续白昼仍可带来较高日平均值。未计反射和大气效应前，全球面积加权平均是光束法向辐照度的四分之一。

why.key: Sunspot observation shows an actual solar image separately. Sunspots are cooler magnetic regions, but the switch does not change the fixed irradiance used here. Neither chart nor globe calculates clouds, atmospheric absorption, surface albedo, weather or a solar forecast. Rotate, change latitude and declination, and keep local-noon, daily-mean and surface readings distinct.
why.zh: 太阳黑子观测另用真实太阳影像展示。黑子是温度较低的磁活动区域，但该开关不改变本模型固定的辐照度。图表和球体不计算云、大气吸收、地表反照率或天气。改变纬度和赤纬时，请区分正午值、日平均值与地表实测值。

steps.key: At zero declination compare the equator, 60° and a pole.
steps.zh: 将赤纬设为 0°，比较赤道、60° 纬度和极点。

steps.key: Change declination to each solstice limit and compare noon with daily mean.
steps.zh: 分别调到夏至、冬至的赤纬极值，比较正午值和全天平均值。

steps.key: Explain cosine projection and why night lowers a daily mean.
steps.zh: 解释余弦投影关系，以及夜晚为何会降低全天平均入射辐射。

steps.key: 4 questions with explanations. Give a reason for each choice; there is no score gate.
steps.zh: 4 道题，附解析。请说明选择理由。

script.key:
Set declination to 0° and latitude to 0°, then 60°; predict the factor of two.
Compare local noon with the seven daily-mean bars.
Set +23.44° and locate polar day in the north; reverse the sign.
Explain why low Sun and long daylight are separate influences.
Open the Sunspot observation and distinguish an observation from this fixed calculation.
Finish in Check.
script.zh:
将赤纬设为 0°，比较赤道、60° 纬度和极点。
分别调到夏至、冬至的赤纬极值，比较正午值和全天平均值。
解释余弦投影关系，以及夜晚为何会降低全天平均入射辐射。
最后完成自测，请学生说明判断依据。

pitfalls.key: Calling beam-normal irradiance a playground measurement.
pitfalls.zh: 把光束法向辐照度当成操场测量值。

pitfalls.key: Forgetting night when interpreting a daily mean.
pitfalls.zh: 解读日平均时忘记黑夜。

pitfalls.key: Treating sunspot visibility as the cause of seasons.
pitfalls.zh: 把可见黑子当成季节成因。

misconceptions.key: Sunspots cause seasons.
misconceptions.zh: 太阳黑子造成四季。

misconceptions.key: Tilt causes seasons. Sunspots are a small, separate story.
misconceptions.zh: 四季主要来自地轴倾角，黑子变化是另一种较小的影响。

misconceptions.key: The poles are cold because they are farther from the Sun in kilometres that matter.
misconceptions.zh: 两极寒冷主要因为离太阳远很多。

misconceptions.key: The extra distance is tiny next to 1 AU. The beam is oblique. That is the cut.
misconceptions.zh: 额外距离相对 1 AU 很小；入射角和日照时长更重要。

misconceptions.key: The solar constant is what hits a London playground.
misconceptions.zh: 太阳常数就是伦敦操场收到的辐照度。

misconceptions.key: The constant is top of atmosphere. Surface flux is less: air and angle both take a share.
misconceptions.zh: 该值对应大气层顶光束法向面积；地表还受入射角、大气和周围环境影响。

objective.key: Compare three centre distances, read light-travel time and distinguish physical body sizes from enlarged locators.
objective.zh: 比较三个中心间距离，读取光传播时间，区分天体实际大小与放大的定位标记。

why.key: A kilometre, an astronomical unit and a light-year all measure distance. One astronomical unit is exactly 149597870.7 km. A light-year is the distance light travels in a Julian year of 365.25 days, at 299792.458 km/s in vacuum. It is not a unit of time.
why.zh: 千米、天文单位和光年都表示距离。1 AU 精确等于 149597870.7 km。1 光年是光以真空速度 299792.458 km/s 在 365.25 天的儒略年中传播的距离，不是时间单位。

why.key: The first view uses the mean Earth–Moon centre distance of 384400 km; actual separation varies. The second uses 1 AU as a Sun–Earth reference. The third uses a rounded 4.24 light-years to Proxima Centauri, the nearest star to the Sun. A new distance scale is selected at every jump; the line does not show celestial coordinates or the positions of other stars.
why.zh: 第一档使用平均地月中心距 384400 km，实际距离会变化；第二档用 1 AU 作为日地参考距离；第三档采用比邻星距离约 4.24 光年。每次切换都会改变距离比例，连线不表示天球坐标或其他恒星的位置。

why.key: The default view enlarges bodies and reports each radius multiplier. T makes both body radii and centre separation use the same scale. At interstellar scale the stars become smaller than a pixel. Small wire locators and labels remain visible as symbols; their widths never mean stellar diameters. A single-scale drawing is possible, but a classroom screen cannot resolve all its bodies at once.
why.zh: 默认天体被放大，页面标明各自半径倍数。T 使半径与中心距共用比例，恒星际尺度下天体会小于像素。定位线框与标签仍可见，但其宽度不是恒星直径。统一比例可以绘制，却无法让课堂屏幕同时分辨所有天体。

why.key: Play moves one light signal uniformly along the chosen centre-to-centre reference distance. At 1× speed, every full playback lasts 24 seconds, while the readout gives the corresponding physical travel time: about 1.28 seconds, 499 seconds or 4.24 years. This ignores light-time corrections from moving endpoints and is not a spacecraft trajectory. Stops at nearby stars keep the comparison readable without pretending to map the whole universe.
why.zh: 播放时，一个光信号沿中心距匀速前进。1× 下每次播放均为 24 秒，读数给出对应的物理传播时间：约 1.28 秒、499 秒或 4.24 年。模型忽略两端运动引起的光时修正，也不是航天器轨迹或完整宇宙地图。

steps.key: Read the mean Earth–Moon distance and start a light signal.
steps.zh: 读出日地体系中地月平均距离，并发出一个光信号。

steps.key: Press T, then jump to 1 AU and to the nearest stellar neighbour.
steps.zh: 按 T 查看真实大小，再切到 1 AU 和最近的恒星邻域。

steps.key: Explain why physical body sizes disappear while locator symbols remain.
steps.zh: 解释为何真实比例下天体小到难以辨认，而定位标记仍然可见。

steps.key: 3 questions with explanations. Give a reason for each choice; there is no score gate.
steps.zh: 3 道附解析的题目。为每个选择说明理由，无通关分数要求。

script.key:
Read the first ruler and play the Earth–Moon light journey.
Press T and compare actual radii with separation.
Jump to 1 AU; read roughly 499 seconds.
Jump to Proxima and identify the enlarged locator symbols.
Explain why each animation lasts 24 seconds at 1× speed but each physical journey differs.
Finish in Check.
script.zh:
读出日地体系中地月平均距离，并发出一个光信号。
按 T 查看真实大小，再切到 1 AU 和最近的恒星邻域。
解释为何真实比例下天体小到难以辨认，而定位标记仍然可见。
最后完成自测，请学生说明判断依据。

pitfalls.key: Calling a light-year a time unit.
pitfalls.zh: 把光年说成时间单位。

pitfalls.key: Reading locator width as stellar diameter.
pitfalls.zh: 把定位符号宽度当成恒星直径。

pitfalls.key: Treating the selected line as a sky map.
pitfalls.zh: 把选定连线当成星图。

misconceptions.key: Space pictures are a single scale.
misconceptions.zh: 所有太空图片都使用单一比例。

misconceptions.key: Every poster hides a jump.
misconceptions.zh: 许多展示图会改变距离或天体大小比例，应先核对比例尺。

misconceptions.key: The next stars sit just beyond Neptune on the same poster.
misconceptions.zh: 在同一张图上，最近恒星就在海王星外面一点。

misconceptions.key: That is a jump of scale that makes planets vanish. Light years, not AU.
misconceptions.zh: 恒星距离以光年计，切换到这一尺度后行星几乎无法辨认。

misconceptions.key: If Earth is a pea, the Sun is another pea beside it.
misconceptions.zh: 如果地球是一颗豌豆，太阳就是旁边的另一颗豌豆。

misconceptions.key: The Sun is a much larger ball a good walk away. This lab still exaggerates.
misconceptions.zh: 太阳直径远大于地球，真实间距也远大于两个球的大小。

objective.key: Read Ma, compare unequal durations and distinguish an enlarged time window from a changed geological history.
objective.zh: 理解 Ma，比较不同地质时期的时长，区分时间窗口放大与真实历史的改变。

why.key: Ma means millions of years; on this page it labels time before the present. Earth is approximately 4.54 billion years old. The full viewing window begins at that estimate. It is not the exact onset of the Hadean on the ICS chart, which extends back to 4567 Ma.
why.zh: Ma 表示百万年，本页用它表示距今年代。地球年龄约 45.4 亿年，完整窗口从这个估计值开始；它不同于国际地层委员会图表延伸至 4567 Ma 的冥古宙起点。

why.key: The time axis is a constant-radius helix with constant pitch. Equal distances along it therefore represent equal durations. Colours show Hadean, Archaean and Proterozoic intervals, followed by the three eras of the Phanerozoic. The latter begins at 538.8 Ma in the ICS 2026/06 chart. Nearby turns can represent very different times; the coil is not a pile of rock layers.
why.zh: 时间轴为半径和螺距恒定的螺旋，所以等长度对应等时长。颜色分别表示冥古宙、太古宙、元古宙，以及显生宙的三个代。ICS 2026/06 图表中显生宙始于 538.8 Ma。相邻螺旋圈可以相隔很久；这不是岩层堆叠。

why.key: Move Oldest → present and read the selected age. Choose a Phanerozoic or Quaternary window to enlarge a shorter interval; the time per turn changes, not the duration of a geological unit. The enlarged marker is only a visibility symbol. Numerical boundary ages can be revised, and many formal boundaries are defined by reference sections rather than an exact numerical age.
why.zh: 移动时间滑块读取年代；选择显生宙或第四纪窗口可放大较短时段。变化的是每圈代表的时间，地质单位的时长没有改变。定位标记只为可见性而放大。边界年龄可能修订，许多正式边界以标准剖面定义，并非固定数值。

why.key: Pangaea belongs within the last few hundred million years, far after Earth formed. Evidence of life extends back at least about 3.5 billion years, while human history occupies a minute part of the full window. Rock age, the time a valley was excavated and the age of organisms are different questions. This display is not an evolutionary ladder, and equal-height boxes on other charts need not mean equal duration.
why.zh: 盘古大陆存在于最近几亿年，远晚于地球形成。生命证据至少可追溯到约 35 亿年前，人类历史只占末端极小部分。岩石形成、山谷切割和生物出现的年代需分别讨论。该图不是进化阶梯，其他图表中的等高方框也未必表示等时长。

steps.key: Start at the oldest end of the full Earth-history window.
steps.zh: 从完整地球历史窗口中最古老的一端开始。

steps.key: Move towards the present, then enlarge Phanerozoic or Quaternary time.
steps.zh: 向现在移动，再放大显生宙或第四纪。

steps.key: Compare durations using distance along the coil, not box height or screen distance.
steps.zh: 沿盘绕时间轴的长度比较时长，不能用方块高度或屏幕上的直线距离代替。

steps.key: 4 questions with explanations. Give a reason for each choice; there is no score gate.
steps.zh: 4 道题，附解析。请说明选择理由。

script.key:
Select Earth history and move from oldest to present.
Name the long Precambrian intervals before the shorter Phanerozoic.
Choose the Phanerozoic window and compare its three eras.
Choose Quaternary and explain why it now fills the same coil.
Distinguish geological unit boundaries, numerical ages and the approximate age of Earth.
Finish in Check.
script.zh:
从完整地球历史窗口中最古老的一端开始。
向现在移动，再放大显生宙或第四纪。
沿盘绕时间轴的长度比较时长，不能用方块高度或屏幕上的直线距离代替。
最后完成自测，请学生说明判断依据。

pitfalls.key: Treating marker width as event duration.
pitfalls.zh: 把定位标记宽度当成事件持续时间。

pitfalls.key: Treating a coil as rock thickness.
pitfalls.zh: 把螺旋高度当成岩层厚度。

pitfalls.key: Confusing enlarged windows with changed durations.
pitfalls.zh: 把窗口放大误认为地质单位变长。

misconceptions.key: Dinosaurs and humans overlap on a wall chart of equal boxes.
misconceptions.zh: 图上方框一样大，所以非鸟类恐龙与现代人生活在同一时期。

misconceptions.key: Boxes lie. The spiral does not.
misconceptions.zh: 方框大小未必表示时间；应比较实际年代与持续时长。

misconceptions.key: Pangaea is how Earth started.
misconceptions.zh: 地球诞生时就是盘古大陆。

misconceptions.key: Pangaea is late. 4500 Ma is the birth mark. Supercontinents come and go.
misconceptions.zh: 盘古大陆出现得晚得多，超大陆在地质历史中多次聚合与分裂。

misconceptions.key: The Grand Canyon hole is as old as the rock in the walls.
misconceptions.zh: 大峡谷谷地和谷壁岩石同样古老。

misconceptions.key: Walls are rock age. The hole is younger. Deep time is not one number for both.
misconceptions.zh: 岩石形成在先，峡谷切割在后，两者年龄不同。

objective.key: Show umbra/penumbra and why a 5° lunar-orbit tilt makes eclipses rare.
objective.zh: 观察本影与半影，并解释月球轨道约 5° 的倾斜为何使日月食较少发生。

why.key: A lunar eclipse happens when the Moon enters Earth’s shadow. A solar eclipse happens when the Moon hides part or all of the Sun for an observer on Earth. New and full Moon occur much more often than eclipses because the lunar orbit is inclined to the ecliptic.
why.zh: 月食发生在月球进入地球影子时。日食发生在地球上某些观测者看到月球遮住部分或全部太阳时。月球轨道相对黄道倾斜，因此新月和满月远比日月食常见。

why.key: The orbit is tilted by 5.145°. Its two nodes are where it crosses the ecliptic plane. Rotate Node direction to align a node with the Sun while keeping that real tilt. The alignment toggle is a separate experiment that makes the two planes coincide; real eclipses do not require the inclination to become zero. Umbra blocks the entire solar disc; penumbra blocks part of it.
why.zh: 轨道倾角采用 5.145°，两交点是月球轨道穿过黄道面的位置。调整交点方向，可在保留真实倾角的同时让交点朝向太阳。另设的对齐开关让两平面重合，属于独立演示；真实日月食不要求倾角变为零。本影完全遮住太阳圆面，半影只遮住一部分。

why.key: Start in the orbital view, then select Shadow close-up and Lunar or Solar. The close view spans 8.5 hours around full or new Moon; Play and the Transit slider follow that interval. With Node direction at zero, compare the lunar umbra and penumbra. Switch to Solar and vary Moon distance: a nearer Moon can cover the whole Sun, while a farther Moon can leave an annulus. Body radii, distances and shadow widths share one scale in these views.
why.zh: 先看轨道，再进入影锥近景并选择月食或日食。近景覆盖新月或满月前后共 8.5 小时，播放和凌越滑块共同控制时间。交点方向为零时比较本影与半影；日食中改变月距，近月可完全遮日，远月可能留下光环。这些视图中天体半径、距离和影宽使用统一比例。

why.key: The circular orbit and spherical bodies form a geometry experiment, not an eclipse-date or safe-viewing calculator. The displayed lunar shadow omits atmospheric refraction; the brown Moon tint is illustrative. Use the genuine eclipse photograph and NASA source if WebGL is unavailable, then explain why a phase is different from a shadow.
why.zh: 圆轨道与球形天体构成几何实验，并非食日期预测或安全观测工具。月影未计大气折射，月面棕色是说明性着色。无法使用三维时，可用真实食照片和 NASA 来源区分月相与投影。

steps.key: Predict whether every full Moon enters Earth’s shadow. Keep the real tilt and set Node direction to 60°. Observe the miss.
steps.zh: 预测每次满月是否都会进入地球影子。保持实际倾角，将交点方向设为 60°，观察错过影子的情况。

steps.key: Select Shadow close-up, Lunar and Node direction 0°. Scrub through the umbra and penumbra. Choose Solar and compare near and far Moon distances.
steps.zh: 选择影子近景、月食及 0° 交点方向，拖动进程穿过本影和半影；再选日食，比较月球远近位置。

steps.key: Return to the orbit and distinguish phase, node and eclipse. Finish in Check.
steps.zh: 返回轨道视图，区分月相、轨道交点与食，再完成自测。

steps.key: 4 questions with explanations. Give a reason for each choice; there is no score gate.
steps.zh: 4 道题，附解析。请说明选择理由。

script.key:
Predict whether every full Moon enters Earth’s shadow.
Keep the real tilt and set Node direction to 60°. Observe the miss.
Select Shadow close-up, Lunar and Node direction 0°. Scrub through the umbra and penumbra.
Choose Solar and compare near and far Moon distances.
Return to the orbit and distinguish phase, node and eclipse. Finish in Check.
script.zh:
预测每次满月是否都会进入地球影子。保持实际倾角，将交点方向设为 60°，观察错过影子的情况。
选择影子近景、月食及 0° 交点方向，拖动进程穿过本影和半影；再选日食，比较月球远近位置。
返回轨道视图，区分月相、轨道交点与食，再完成自测。
最后完成自测，请学生说明判断依据。

pitfalls.key: Crescent as Earth’s shadow.
pitfalls.zh: 用地球影子解释普通月牙。

pitfalls.key: Teaching every full Moon as an eclipse.
pitfalls.zh: 把每次满月都讲成月食。

pitfalls.key: Saying the Moon is too small to ever hit, instead of naming the 5° tilt.
pitfalls.zh: 只说月球太小，不解释约 5° 的轨道倾角。

misconceptions.key: Every full Moon is an eclipse.
misconceptions.zh: 每次满月都会发生月食。

misconceptions.key: Need a node.
misconceptions.zh: 还需月球位于轨道交点附近，形成对齐。

misconceptions.key: A crescent is Earth’s shadow on the Moon.
misconceptions.zh: 月牙是地球投在月球上的影子。

misconceptions.key: A crescent is the Moon’s night side. Earth’s shadow is a lunar eclipse, and it is rare.
misconceptions.zh: 月牙暗部是月球自身的夜面；地球影子造成月食。

misconceptions.key: The Moon is too small to ever cover the Sun.
misconceptions.zh: 月球太小，永远无法遮住太阳。

misconceptions.key: Angular size can match. The reason most months miss is the 5° tilt, not a tiny Moon.
misconceptions.zh: 两者视直径可相近；多数月份没有日食主要因为轨道倾斜，而非月球太小。

objective.key: Show two tidal bulges and spring/neap with Moon–Sun alignment.
objective.zh: 观察两侧潮汐隆起，并用日月相对位置解释大潮与小潮。

why.key: Holderness waves ride a tidal range. Estuaries even more. The Mississippi meets a modest Gulf tide and still dumps a delta; UK east-coast mudflats live on a larger clock. Spring and neap are alignment, not April. A Leeds student who thinks spring tide waits for daffodils will misread every tide table from the Humber to Miami. Yosemite has no sea, but the same Moon that pulls Holderness pulls a California coast twice a day. Hawaii sits in a different basin with a different range; the two-bulge idea still holds as the school start. Fieldwork on a UK beach is a timetable. Miss the range and you miss the spit, the mud, the harbour gate. The skill is two bulges, then syzygy versus quadrature. Wind is weather. Rivers are catchments. Neither is the second bulge.
why.zh: 海岸潮差因海盆形状和传播条件而异。潮滩、港口和野外考察都需要真实潮汐资料。本实验从理想平衡潮的双隆起出发，比较日月近共线与成直角的情形；不能用同一潮差代表霍尔德内斯、墨西哥湾和夏威夷。

why.key: Input is a month. The Moon goes around. The Sun sits off-stage, weaker, not zero. Two bulges: one toward the Moon, one opposite. That opposite bulge is the school model — gravity plus the orbiting-system’s inertia — and the teacher notes flag the simplification. What moves: the Moon’s place, which way the fat water points, whether the Sun’s smaller pull adds or fights. What does not: the existence of two bulges, Earth’s spin as the thing that carries a coast through those bulges twice a day, in the simple picture. What is conserved: mass of water, the fortnightly spring–neap beat, the fact that new and full are both syzygy. Align Sun and Moon along one line: spring tide, larger range, twice a month, named for leaping, not the season. Right angles: neap, smaller range, quarter moons. The lie the model tells: water is a deformed mesh around a smooth globe; continents do not get in the way; real amphidromes, basins, and coastal funnelling are missing. Holderness and the Gulf are not the same range. The mechanism still starts here. Tsunamis are not tides. Wind setup is not the two-bulge clock.
why.zh: 月球引力在地球各处不同，减去地球中心的共同加速度后，形成朝月和背月两侧的理想潮汐隆起。太阳也产生潮汐，作用较弱但不为零。日地月近共线时形成较大潮差的大潮，新月和满月均可出现；方向成直角时形成较小潮差的小潮，对应上下弦附近。模型忽略大陆、海盆共振、无潮点和海岸收窄。

why.key: Play the month. Space toggles play. Arrows nudge time. Speed 1×, 2×, 4×. No extra slider. No toggle. L labels. R reset. P projector. No explode, no slice. Pause when the readout says spring — Sun and Moon aligned. Pause on neap — quadrature. Ask which phases give spring before you reveal: new or full, both. Quarter moons give neap. Reset if the class has named the season by accident. The month slider is the only clock. Watch the mesh deform; it is not a sticker. Name spring and neap from alignment, not from the calendar.
why.zh: 播放月份，观察月球方位与水面形状共同改变。在大潮和小潮处暂停，先根据位置判断，再核对名称。空格播放，方向键调时间，L 标签，R 重置，P 投影。月份滑块控制过程，水面隆起是夸张展示。

why.key: If the bulges will not spin, keep the sentences. Two bulges: toward the Moon and opposite. Spring tide is larger range when Sun and Moon pull along one line, twice a month, not in April. Neap is smaller range at right angles. The Sun is weaker than the Moon here, but not zero. Holderness rides a real range. Gulf tides can be modest. This is a school two-bulge model, not a harbour forecast. That is enough for Check on paper.
why.zh: 双隆起是教学起点，不代表每个海岸每天都严格出现两次等高高潮。真实潮汐需考虑海洋动力学。海啸不是潮汐，风引起的增水也不是双隆起周期；本实验不能代替港口潮汐预报。

steps.key: Two bulges: toward the Moon and opposite.
steps.zh: 辨认朝向月球和背向月球的两个理想潮汐隆起。

steps.key: Play the month. Align Sun and Moon: spring. Right angle: neap.
steps.zh: 播放一个月：日月大致共线时比较大潮，成直角时比较小潮。

steps.key: Sun is weaker but not zero.
steps.zh: 太阳的引潮作用比月球弱，但不能忽略。

steps.key: 4 questions with explanations. Give a reason for each choice; there is no score gate.
steps.zh: 4 道题，附解析。请说明选择理由。

script.key:
Play the month. Two bulges: one toward the Moon, one opposite.
That two-bulge picture is a school model. Flag the simplification.
When Sun and Moon pull along one line, the range is larger: spring tide.
Spring as in leap, twice a month, not the season.
At right angles the bulges fight: neap tide, smaller range.
The Sun is weaker than the Moon here, but not zero.
Ask which phase gives spring: new or full — both, syzygy.
Quarter moons give neap.
Spring tides do not wait for April. That is the trap.
Finish in Check.
script.zh:
辨认朝向月球和背向月球的两个理想潮汐隆起。
播放一个月：日月大致共线时比较大潮，成直角时比较小潮。
太阳的引潮作用比月球弱，但不能忽略。
最后完成自测，请学生说明判断依据。

pitfalls.key: Season named spring.
pitfalls.zh: 把 spring tide 理解为春季潮汐。

pitfalls.key: Only one bulge, facing the Moon.
pitfalls.zh: 只画朝月的一处隆起。

pitfalls.key: Calling a tsunami a tide, or wind setup the two-bulge clock.
pitfalls.zh: 把海啸或风增水当成双隆起潮汐周期。

misconceptions.key: Spring tides happen in April.
misconceptions.zh: Spring tide 只在春季发生。

misconceptions.key: Spring as in leap, twice a month.
misconceptions.zh: 它指大潮，一般每个朔望月出现两次，与春季无关。

misconceptions.key: There is only one bulge, the one facing the Moon.
misconceptions.zh: 只有朝向月球的一侧有潮汐隆起。

misconceptions.key: Two. Toward the Moon and opposite. The second is the school-model surprise.
misconceptions.zh: 理想平衡潮在朝月和背月两侧都有隆起。

misconceptions.key: The Sun does not affect tides.
misconceptions.zh: 太阳不影响潮汐。

misconceptions.key: Weaker than the Moon, not zero. Alignment is why springs beat neaps.
misconceptions.zh: 太阳潮汐较弱但不为零，日月相对方向影响大小潮。

objective.key: Read noon altitude and day length from a sun-path dome for London, Nairobi, New York.
objective.zh: 在太阳轨迹穹顶中读取伦敦、内罗毕与纽约的正午太阳高度和昼长。

why.key: London in December is a low noon and a short day. Miami still has a useful beam. Same dome idea. Different latitude. Leeds glasshouses plot hours above a height that plants can use. Florida growers plot the same curve with a different φ. Snowdonia fieldwork in June is a long arc; the same slope in December is a brief, low Sun. New York sits between London and Miami on that ladder. The skill is to read noon altitude and day length from a path, not from a weather app. Pairs with the calculator tool. A magnetic compass is not true south. Overhead Sun is not a global noon habit. If you cannot move latitude in your head from 51.5° to 0°, you cannot compare a UK playground with Nairobi, and you will keep saying the Sun is overhead everywhere at lunch.
why.zh: 伦敦冬季正午太阳低、白昼短；较低纬度的迈阿密同期太阳更高。比较同一地点的季节变化与不同地点的纬度变化，才能理解太阳路径。正午并不意味着太阳处处直射，磁罗盘所指的南也不等同于真南。

why.key: Input is latitude, plus the time slider that walks the Sun along the dome. Default latitude is 51.5°, London. The path is the day’s arc on a sky hemisphere over a marked horizon. Noon altitude is 90° minus the absolute difference of latitude and declination: 90° − |φ − δ|. Day length falls out of whether the path clears the horizon, and for how long. What moves: the Sun along the arc, the length of that arc when you change φ, the gnomon’s shadow. What does not: the formula, the fact of a horizon, the fact that overhead Sun only happens between the tropics, and not every day. What is conserved: spherical geometry. Raise latitude in winter: noon Sun drops, day shortens. Toward the equator: noon stays high, day length sits near 12 h. Polar extremes are a longer day or a night that will not end, depending on season, but this slider caps short of the pole. The lie the model tells: a small dome, a fat Sun, a toy gnomon, a teaching plinth instead of a real playground. The path is the lesson. The numbers on the readout are the lesson. Seasons still come from tilt; this lab aims the beam for one place.
why.zh: 正午太阳高度为 90° − |φ − δ|，其中 φ 为纬度，δ 为太阳赤纬。日长由太阳轨迹在地平线以上的部分决定。改变纬度和日期会改变路径，时间滑块控制太阳沿路径移动，立杆影子随之变化。直射只可能出现在两回归线之间，且并非每天都有。

why.key: Leave Latitude near 51.5°. That is London. Play. Space toggles play. Arrows nudge the Sun along the path. Speed 1×, 2×, 4×. Drag Latitude toward 0° for Nairobi, or toward Miami’s band, or south. Read noon altitude and day length from the readout. L labels. R reset. P projector. No explode, no slice in the bar. Reset if the dome has walked off a useful latitude. True south is not a magnetic compass. The Latitude slider is the extra. The time slider walks the Sun on the dome. Read the gnomon shadow as well as the numbers.
why.zh: 先在约北纬 51.5° 比较日期和时刻，再移向赤道或南半球。一起读取正午高度、日长和立杆影子，避免只看其中一个量。空格播放，方向键微调，L 标签，R 重置，P 投影。

why.key: If the dome will not spin, keep the formula and the places. Noon altitude = 90° − |φ − δ|. London winter: low noon, short day. Equator: day length near 12 h, noon Sun high. Overhead at noon only between the tropics, and not every day. Raising latitude in winter lowers the Sun and shortens the day. Miami is not London. Snowdonia in June is not Snowdonia in December. That is enough for Check on paper, and enough to kill ‘the Sun is overhead everywhere at noon’.
why.zh: 穹顶、太阳圆面和立杆都为课堂展示而放大。公式给出几何关系，不包含具体操场地形和天气遮挡。赤道日长接近 12 小时，中高纬季节差异更明显；高纬度夏冬变化方向不同。

steps.key: Dome. Today’s path. London marker.
steps.zh: 观察天空穹顶、当天太阳路径和伦敦位置。

steps.key: Scrub date. Change latitude toward Nairobi.
steps.zh: 拖动日期，并将纬度调向内罗毕。

steps.key: Noon altitude = 90° − |φ − δ|.
steps.zh: 用纬度 φ 和赤纬 δ 计算：正午太阳高度角 = 90° − 两者之差的绝对值。

steps.key: 4 questions with explanations. Give a reason for each choice; there is no score gate.
steps.zh: 4 道题，附解析。请说明选择理由。

script.key:
Leave Latitude near 51.5°. That is London.
Play. Watch the path on the dome. Read noon altitude and day length.
The Sun is overhead at noon only between the tropics, and not every day.
That is the misconception: overhead everywhere.
Scrub Latitude toward the equator, near Nairobi.
Day length sits nearer 12 h. Noon Sun stays high.
Raising latitude in winter lowers noon Sun and shortens the day.
Noon altitude is 90° minus the absolute difference of latitude and declination.
A magnetic compass is not true south. Say that once.
Finish in Check.
script.zh:
观察天空穹顶、当天太阳路径和伦敦位置。
拖动日期，并将纬度调向内罗毕。
用纬度 φ 和赤纬 δ 计算：正午太阳高度角 = 90° − 两者之差的绝对值。
最后完成自测，请学生说明判断依据。

pitfalls.key: Magnetic compass vs true south.
pitfalls.zh: 混淆磁南与真南。

pitfalls.key: Overhead Sun as a global noon habit.
pitfalls.zh: 把正午直射当成全球现象。

pitfalls.key: Forgetting that day length and noon altitude both move with latitude.
pitfalls.zh: 忘记纬度同时改变日长和正午高度。

misconceptions.key: The Sun is overhead at noon everywhere.
misconceptions.zh: 太阳在正午处处位于头顶。

misconceptions.key: Only between the tropics, and not every day.
misconceptions.zh: 直射只可能出现在两回归线之间，且不是每天都有。

misconceptions.key: Day length is 12 hours everywhere, every day.
misconceptions.zh: 所有地点每天都是 12 小时白昼。

misconceptions.key: Near 12 h at the equator. London swings from a short December to a long June.
misconceptions.zh: 赤道附近较接近 12 小时，伦敦则从冬季短昼变为夏季长昼。

misconceptions.key: Raising latitude always makes the Sun higher.
misconceptions.zh: 纬度升高一定使太阳更高。

misconceptions.key: In winter it lowers noon Sun and shortens the day. Geometry, not a hill.
misconceptions.zh: 同一半球冬季向高纬移动，通常正午太阳更低、白昼更短。

objective.key: Scrub 250 Ma to now, toggle fossil/fit overlay, and treat Pangaea as the same plates earlier.
objective.zh: 从 2.5 亿年前拖动至今，切换化石与大陆拼合叠加图，理解盘古大陆是这些板块过去的组合。

why.key: A GCSE class that still thinks continents plough a static ocean will misread Iceland, the Himalaya, and every earthquake map that follows. The United Kingdom is not a plate. It rides the Eurasian plate. The Mid-Atlantic Ridge at Iceland is where that plate is born, a few centimetres per year, with a country sitting on the split. San Andreas is the United States pair: the Pacific and North American plates slide past, so California’s hazard is transform motion, not a continent chewing through a frozen Pacific. Wegener’s coast fit and matching fossils across the young Atlantic are the evidence. Plates are the mechanism he did not have. Himalaya collision is the same machine stacking crust that Iceland makes at a ridge. If the ocean floor were static, those fossils would be a miracle and India would have no walk north into Eurasia. News maps that freeze today’s beaches as eternal outlines hide 250 million years of passengers. Treat Pangaea as the same plates at an earlier time, not a mythic first Earth.
why.zh: 大陆漂移需要结合板块运动理解：冰岛位于扩张脊，喜马拉雅记录大陆碰撞，圣安德烈亚斯是转换边界。英国位于欧亚板块上，本身不是一个板块。大陆轮廓、化石和古气候证据共同支持过去的连接。

why.key: Continents are passengers on lithospheric plates. Oceanic lithosphere is plate too: born at ridges, destroyed at trenches. From about 300 to 180 Ma a supercontinent, Pangaea, sat assembled. It was not Earth’s starting position and not the only supercontinent in the record. After it rifted, the Atlantic opened. India walked north and stacked into Eurasia as the Himalaya. Wegener argued fit, fossils, and palaeoclimate; he lacked a driving mechanism. Seafloor spreading and subduction supply it. Fit the continental shelves, not today’s beaches: the real outline is the shelf edge, the shallow submerged margin. Matching fossils across South America and Africa sit on crust that was once adjacent. The United Kingdom was already a Eurasian passenger. San Andreas did not yet cut California as it does now. The globe uses EarthByte’s Müller 2019 plate reconstruction at 10 Ma intervals. It reconstructs modern coastline shapes; these are not ancient shorelines. The green land and blue sea are a cartographic colour key, not a reconstruction of ancient vegetation or water depth. Plate positions follow the published reconstruction rather than straight interpolation. Fossil evidence is described in the readout, not plotted as measured assemblages. What remains true: the pieces fit at the shelf, the Atlantic is young, India has moved north, and neither continent nor ocean is a static stage.
why.zh: 大陆与海洋岩石圈同属板块。洋壳在洋中脊形成并可在俯冲带消减。盘古大陆约在 300–180 Ma 期间聚合存在，后来裂开，大西洋张开，印度北移并与欧亚碰撞。拼合应参考大陆边缘，而非今天的沙滩。球体采用 EarthByte Müller 2019 重建、每 10 Ma 一个快照；重建的是现代海岸线形状的位置，不是古海岸线。绿蓝色只是图例，不表示古植被或水深。化石证据用文字说明，并非实测点位图。

why.key: Set Ma before present to 250 Ma, then compare the 10 Ma snapshots towards the present. Orbit the globe to follow India and the opening Atlantic. Fossil / fit overlay adds the evidence note below the globe. The age slider selects the reconstruction directly; this lesson does not use a separate playback clock. R resets the defaults, P switches projector mode, and Ctrl + scroll zooms.
why.zh: 从距今 250 Ma 开始，对比直到现代的各个 10 Ma 快照。旋转追踪印度与大西洋，打开化石／拼合证据说明。年龄滑块直接选择重建快照，本课没有另一套播放时钟。R 重置，P 投影，Ctrl＋滚轮缩放。

why.key: Without the 3D view the lesson still holds. At about 250 Ma the continental shelves fit as Pangaea. Matching fossils across the South Atlantic are the evidence; plates are the mechanism. Continents do not plough a static ocean: both are plate. Iceland makes crust at a ridge. The Himalaya stacks it at collision. San Andreas slides. The United Kingdom rides Eurasia. Kola never cored this history; we reconstruct it from fit, fossils, and the ocean floor. If JavaScript is off you still have the caption, the glossary, and Check. Draw two outlines, fit the shelves, then pull them apart. That sketch is the model.
why.zh: 不用三维时，可先拼合大陆边缘，再用跨洋对应化石解释证据。板块机制还需结合海底扩张与俯冲理解；盘古大陆不是地球最初状态，也不是唯一的超大陆。

steps.key: Pangaea. Fit the coasts.
steps.zh: 观察盘古大陆，并比较大陆边缘的大致拼合。

steps.key: Scrub to now. India walks north.
steps.zh: 拖动时间到现代，追踪印度向北移动。

steps.key: Fossils and fit are evidence. Plates are the mechanism.
steps.zh: 区分化石与地质拼合等证据，以及板块构造提供的运动机制。

steps.key: 4 questions with explanations. Give a reason for each choice; there is no score gate.
steps.zh: 4 道题，附解析。请说明选择理由。

script.key:
Set Ma before present to 250 Ma. The pieces fit.
Toggle Fossil / fit overlay on. Fossils and the shelf edge are the evidence.
Fit continental shelves, not today’s beaches.
Scrub toward now. India walks north.
Pangaea is a late Palaeozoic–Mesozoic supercontinent, not Earth’s starting position, and not the only one.
Continents do not plough a static ocean. Both are plate.
They are passengers. Ocean floor is plate too.
Wegener had the fit. Plates are the mechanism.
Name Iceland (makes crust), Himalaya (stacks it), San Andreas (slides).
The United Kingdom rides Eurasia. It is not a plate.
Pause near 0 Ma and name what changed.
Finish in Check.
script.zh:
观察盘古大陆，并比较大陆边缘的大致拼合。
拖动时间到现代，追踪印度向北移动。
区分化石与地质拼合等证据，以及板块构造提供的运动机制。
最后完成自测，请学生说明判断依据。

pitfalls.key: Pangaea as the only supercontinent.
pitfalls.zh: 把盘古大陆当成唯一超大陆。

pitfalls.key: Fitting today’s beaches instead of continental shelves.
pitfalls.zh: 拼现代海滩而非大陆边缘。

pitfalls.key: Calling the United Kingdom a plate. It rides Eurasia.
pitfalls.zh: 把英国称为独立板块。

pitfalls.key: Drawing the ocean as a static floor continents plough through.
pitfalls.zh: 把海底画成大陆犁过的静止背景。

misconceptions.key: Continents plough through static oceans.
misconceptions.zh: 大陆从静止的海底中犁过去。

misconceptions.key: Both are plate.
misconceptions.zh: 大陆和海洋岩石圈都属于运动板块。

misconceptions.key: Pangaea was Earth’s first crust, and the only supercontinent.
misconceptions.zh: 盘古大陆是最初地壳，也是唯一超大陆。

misconceptions.key: It is a late Palaeozoic–Mesozoic assembly, not a starting position, and not the only one.
misconceptions.zh: 它是晚古生代至中生代的聚合体，地球更早已有其他超大陆。

misconceptions.key: You fit today’s beaches to prove drift.
misconceptions.zh: 应精确拼合今天的沙滩来证明漂移。

misconceptions.key: Fit continental shelves. The holiday sand is not the outline.
misconceptions.zh: 应比较大陆边缘，现代海滩受侵蚀和沉积影响。

objective.key: Infer relative plate motion from age direction in the independent Hawaiʻi and Yellowstone examples.
objective.zh: 分别利用夏威夷和黄石实例中的年龄变化方向，推断板块的相对运动。

why.key: Most volcanism occurs near plate boundaries, but intraplate volcanism also occurs. Hotspots are persistent centres of anomalous volcanism commonly associated with mantle upwelling. A plume is a thermal anomaly in mostly solid mantle, not a hole or a liquid pipe through the entire Earth. As hot rock rises, decompression can cause partial melting.
why.zh: 大部分火山活动靠近板块边界，也有板内火山。热点是持续异常火山活动中心，常与地幔上涌有关。地幔柱是以固态为主的热异常，不是贯穿地球的熔岩管；热岩石上升减压时可能部分熔融。

why.key: Hawaiʻi and Yellowstone are separate systems. In the main Hawaiian island chain, older volcanoes generally lie northwest of the currently active southeastern end; Kauaʻi preserves rocks about 5–5.5 Ma old. The Yellowstone track becomes older southwestwards along the Snake River Plain and extends back roughly 17 Ma. The model shows selected age snapshots, not dated intermediate outlines or the entire Hawaiian–Emperor chain.
why.zh: 夏威夷与黄石是独立系统。夏威夷主岛链通常向西北变老，东南端目前活跃，考艾岛岩石约 5–5.5 Ma。黄石轨迹沿蛇河平原向西南变老，可追溯约 17 Ma。模型展示选定年龄节点，并不重建完整夏威夷—皇帝海山链或中间喷发轮廓。

why.key: Enable either or both tracks. Each section is rotated for side-by-side comparison: right means northwest in Hawaiʻi and southwest in Yellowstone. Play follows relative plate motion above a fixed teaching anomaly; it does not slide real mapped island outlines or reconstruct an eruption chronology. Plate thickness, volcanic shapes and thermal colours are schematic. Hotspots need not remain perfectly fixed, and crustal extension also contributes to the Yellowstone track.
why.zh: 可单独或同时显示两条轨迹。为并排比较，右方分别代表夏威夷的西北和黄石的西南。播放表示板块相对固定教学热异常的运动，地形、厚度与热色均为示意。热点不一定完全固定，黄石轨迹还受地壳伸展影响。

why.key: An oceanic shield-volcano chain and continental caldera centres differ in crust, magma evolution and surface expression. Iceland combines a spreading-ridge setting with anomalously hot mantle; Cascadia is a subduction setting. These are not interchangeable volcanic mechanisms. Neither an age-progressive track nor a glowing model region predicts the timing, size or location of a future eruption.
why.zh: 海洋盾状火山链与大陆破火山口在地壳、岩浆演化和地表形态上不同。冰岛同时涉及扩张脊与异常热地幔，卡斯卡迪亚则是俯冲环境。这些机制不能互换，年龄轨迹和发光区域都不能预测未来喷发。

steps.key: Locate the young and older ends of the Hawaiian comparison.
steps.zh: 在夏威夷火山链中找出年轻端和较老端。

steps.key: Enable Yellowstone and compare its different geographic age direction.
steps.zh: 切到黄石，比较地理方向不同的年龄序列。

steps.key: Infer relative plate motion while distinguishing mostly solid mantle from partial melt.
steps.zh: 推断相对板块运动，并区分主要呈固态的地幔与局部熔融。

steps.key: 3 questions with explanations. Give a reason for each choice; there is no score gate.
steps.zh: 3 道附解析的题目。为每个选择说明理由，无通关分数要求。

script.key:
Enable Hawaiʻi and read its two geographic end labels.
Play the relative-motion tracers; infer Pacific motion.
Enable Yellowstone and identify its southwest age direction.
Turn each off in turn to confirm the systems are independent.
Explain thermal upwelling, partial melt and the schematic section scale.
Finish in Check.
script.zh:
在夏威夷火山链中找出年轻端和较老端。
切到黄石，比较地理方向不同的年龄序列。
推断相对板块运动，并区分主要呈固态的地幔与局部熔融。
最后完成自测，请学生说明判断依据。

pitfalls.key: Treating the two examples as one plume.
pitfalls.zh: 把两个案例当作同一地幔柱。

pitfalls.key: Calling the warm mantle region a column of liquid magma.
pitfalls.zh: 把热地幔画成整柱液态岩浆。

pitfalls.key: Reading illustrated landforms as surveyed outlines or dated intermediate eruptions.
pitfalls.zh: 把示意地形当成测绘轮廓或精确喷发序列。

misconceptions.key: All volcanoes lie on plate boundaries.
misconceptions.zh: 所有火山都位于板块边界。

misconceptions.key: Intraplate volcanism includes Hawaiʻi and Yellowstone; their tectonic settings and histories differ.
misconceptions.zh: 夏威夷、黄石都包含板内火山活动，但环境与历史不同。

misconceptions.key: Hawaiʻi and Yellowstone share one lava pipe.
misconceptions.zh: 夏威夷和黄石共用一根熔岩管。

misconceptions.key: They are separate systems on different plates. A hot mantle upwelling is mostly solid, with partial melt possible during ascent.
misconceptions.zh: 两者位于不同板块、属于不同系统；地幔上涌以固态为主，升途中可能部分熔融。

misconceptions.key: A hotspot must stay fixed forever.
misconceptions.zh: 热点必须永远固定。

misconceptions.key: Volcanic age tracks record motion relative to a melting anomaly. Mantle flow and hotspot motion can also matter over long intervals.
misconceptions.zh: 年龄轨迹反映相对热异常的运动，长期地幔流动和热点移动也可能重要。

objective.key: Watch stripes move apart from the Mid-Atlantic Ridge.
objective.zh: 观察磁性条带从大西洋中脊向两侧移动。
