why.key: New oceanic crust forms at a spreading ridge. As it cools, magnetic minerals acquire remanent magnetisation related to the field at that time. Reversals create a record that can be correlated across opposite flanks; the coloured bands are not visible paint on the actual seafloor.
why.zh: 新洋壳在扩张脊形成。冷却时，磁性矿物获得与当时磁场相关的剩磁；地磁反转形成两侧可对应的记录。彩色条带代表极性，不是海底真实可见的油漆。

why.key: The two flanks here move at equal half rates. A full spreading rate of 25 mm/year means each flank moves 12.5 mm/year, or 12.5 km per million years. Age equals distance divided by the half rate. This distinction matters when calculating an ocean-opening rate.
why.zh: 这里两侧以相同半速率移动。全扩张速率 25 mm/年，意味着每侧 12.5 mm/年，即每百万年 12.5 km。年龄等于距脊轴距离除以半速率；计算海洋张开速度时必须区分全速率与半速率。

why.key: Play or scrub Process to move paired markers and an explicitly invented reversal history away from the axis over one million years. Change Full spreading rate and compare ages at the two 50 km endpoints. Teal and sandstone encode opposite magnetic polarities. T restores equal scales; the usual view enlarges vertical dimensions twelvefold.
why.zh: 播放或拖动过程滑块，观察成对标记与虚构极性序列在一百万年内远离脊轴。改变全扩张速率，比较两侧 50 km 处的年龄。蓝绿和砂色表示相反极性。T 恢复同一尺度，默认垂直放大 12 倍。

why.key: The ocean is omitted to expose an upper slice of crust. The simple square-root subsidence curve and synthetic polarity intervals are teaching inputs, not Mid-Atlantic measurements or the real geomagnetic time scale. Actual ridges can spread asymmetrically, shift axis, segment along transforms and vary their rate. Use a real magnetic profile for dating a real ocean floor.
why.zh: 海水被省略，以展示上部地壳。平方根沉降曲线和极性间隔是教学输入，不是大西洋实测值或真实地磁年代尺。真实洋中脊可不对称扩张、迁移、分段并改变速率；实际定年需用真实磁异常剖面。

steps.key: Find the ridge axis and the two same-age endpoint labels. Set the full rate to 25 mm/year; calculate the 12.5 mm/year half rate.
steps.zh: 找出洋中脊轴线和两侧同龄端点。将全扩张速率设为 25 mm/年，计算半扩张速率 12.5 mm/年。

steps.key: Play the invented reversal record and follow paired markers. Compare wider and narrower stripes without assuming a constant reversal period.
steps.zh: 播放假设的地磁反转记录，追踪成对标记。比较宽窄磁条带，不要假定反转间隔固定。

steps.key: Press T, then distinguish teaching inputs from observations.
steps.zh: 按 T 查看真实比例，区分教学输入与实测观测。

steps.key: 4 questions with explanations. Give a reason for each choice; there is no score gate.
steps.zh: 4 道题，附解析。请说明选择理由。

script.key:
Find the ridge axis and the two same-age endpoint labels.
Set the full rate to 25 mm/year; calculate the 12.5 mm/year half rate.
Play the invented reversal record and follow paired markers.
Compare wider and narrower stripes without assuming a constant reversal period.
Press T, then distinguish teaching inputs from observations.
Finish in Check.
script.zh:
找出洋中脊轴线和两侧同龄端点。将全扩张速率设为 25 mm/年，计算半扩张速率 12.5 mm/年。
播放假设的地磁反转记录，追踪成对标记。比较宽窄磁条带，不要假定反转间隔固定。
按 T 查看真实比例，区分教学输入与实测观测。
最后完成自测，请学生说明判断依据。

pitfalls.key: Stripes as waves.
pitfalls.zh: 把磁条带说成波浪。

pitfalls.key: Ocean floor all the same age.
pitfalls.zh: 把海底看成同龄。

pitfalls.key: Calling San Andreas a spreading centre.
pitfalls.zh: 把圣安德烈亚斯称为扩张中心。

pitfalls.key: Forgetting the vertical exaggeration ×12 on the ridge.
pitfalls.zh: 忘记默认洋中脊垂直放大 12 倍。

misconceptions.key: Ocean floor is all the same age.
misconceptions.zh: 所有海底都一样古老。

misconceptions.key: Young at ridges, old at trenches.
misconceptions.zh: 洋中脊处新生，向远处通常变老，旧岩石圈可在海沟俯冲。

misconceptions.key: Magnetic stripes are waves on the sea.
misconceptions.zh: 磁条带是海面波浪。

misconceptions.key: They are polarity frozen in cooling basalt, a tape recorder, not a swell.
misconceptions.zh: 条带是玄武岩冷却时记录的磁极性。

misconceptions.key: San Andreas is a spreading centre, like Iceland.
misconceptions.zh: 圣安德烈亚斯像冰岛一样是扩张中心。

misconceptions.key: San Andreas is transform. Iceland is the ridge. Cascadia is where old floor can be swallowed.
misconceptions.zh: 圣安德烈亚斯是转换边界，冰岛位于扩张脊，卡斯卡迪亚是俯冲环境。

objective.key: Name the main layers, state that weather is tropospheric, and read a lapse rate as temperature falling with height.
objective.zh: 辨认大气主要层次，理解天气主要发生在对流层，并读取气温随高度下降的递减率。

why.key: Earth’s atmosphere has no sharp outer edge. Most weather occurs in the troposphere, a thin part of the atmosphere above the surface. The reference globe uses boundaries at 12, 50 and 85 km, and shows the thermosphere only as far as 500 km; real boundaries vary.
why.zh: 大气没有清晰外边界。大多数天气发生在对流层。本参考球采用 12、50、85 km 的层界，热层只显示到 500 km；真实层界会变化。

why.key: The troposphere is commonly about 8 km deep near the poles and 16–18 km in the tropics. Temperature usually falls through it, rises through much of the stratosphere as ozone absorbs ultraviolet, falls in the mesosphere and rises in the sparse thermosphere. These are temperature-defined gas regions, not solid shells.
why.zh: 对流层在极区常约 8 km，在热带约 16–18 km。温度通常在对流层随高度下降，在平流层因臭氧吸收紫外而升高，中间层再下降，稀薄热层中又升高。它们是按温度结构划分的气体区域，不是固体壳层。

why.key: Use Layer globe to rotate the atmosphere and read the numbered key. Explode separates regions for naming; reset it before comparing altitude. T changes the altitude enlargement from eightfold to the same length scale as Earth. Temperature profile opens a separate, readable graph in °C and km.
why.zh: 旋转圈层球并对照编号。展开功能用于辨认，比较高度前请复原。T 将默认 8 倍高度放大恢复为与地球统一的尺度。温度剖面另以 °C 和 km 显示。

why.key: Lapse rate changes the prescribed tropospheric temperature gradient. At 6.5 °C/km, a 15 °C surface gives −63 °C at 12 km. The chosen average is neither a radiosonde observation nor the cooling rate of every moving parcel. If 3D is unavailable, use the ISS limb photograph, definitions and the teacher note.
why.zh: 递减率控制指定的对流层温度梯度。若地表 15 °C、递减率 6.5 °C/km，则 12 km 处为 −63 °C。这是平均教学剖面，不是探空实测，也不是所有上升气块的冷却率。

steps.key: Open Layer globe and name regions 1–4 using the key. Use Explode to separate the regions, then restore spacing. Press T to compare the altitude scale with Earth’s radius.
steps.zh: 在圈层视图中用图例辨认 1–4 层。先分离再恢复圈层，按 T 比较大气高度与地球半径。

steps.key: Open Temperature profile. At lapse rate 6.5 °C/km, calculate 15 − 12 × 6.5 = −63 °C. Change the lapse rate to 4 °C/km and compare −33 °C.
steps.zh: 打开温度剖面：用 6.5 °C/km 算出 15 − 12 × 6.5 = −63 °C，再调到 4 °C/km，比较 −33 °C。

steps.key: Explain why the stratospheric trend reverses, and why thermospheric temperature does not imply dense hot air. Finish with Check.
steps.zh: 解释平流层温度趋势为何反转，以及热层高温为何不等于稠密热空气，再完成自测。

steps.key: 4 questions with explanations. Give a reason for each choice; there is no score gate.
steps.zh: 4 道题，附解析。请说明选择理由。

script.key:
Open Layer globe and name regions 1–4 using the key.
Use Explode to separate the regions, then restore spacing.
Press T to compare the altitude scale with Earth’s radius.
Open Temperature profile. At lapse rate 6.5 °C/km, calculate 15 − 12 × 6.5 = −63 °C.
Change the lapse rate to 4 °C/km and compare −33 °C.
Explain why the stratospheric trend reverses, and why thermospheric temperature does not imply dense hot air.
Finish with Check.
script.zh:
在圈层视图中用图例辨认 1–4 层。先分离再恢复圈层，按 T 比较大气高度与地球半径。
打开温度剖面：用 6.5 °C/km 算出 15 − 12 × 6.5 = −63 °C，再调到 4 °C/km，比较 −33 °C。
解释平流层温度趋势为何反转，以及热层高温为何不等于稠密热空气，再完成自测。
最后完成自测，请学生说明判断依据。

pitfalls.key: Drawing the troposphere as half the stack.
pitfalls.zh: 把对流层画成半个大气层。

pitfalls.key: Saying we ‘run out of air’ at the tropopause.
pitfalls.zh: 说对流层顶以上没有空气。

pitfalls.key: Leaving exploded shells on the board as if they were to scale.
pitfalls.zh: 把展开壳层当成真实比例。

pitfalls.key: Teaching ‘closer to the Sun’ as the reason the stratosphere warms with height.
pitfalls.zh: 用离太阳更近解释平流层升温。

misconceptions.key: Space begins just above the clouds.
misconceptions.zh: 云层上方立刻就是太空。

misconceptions.key: Clouds are in a thin film. There is a lot of atmosphere above them, but almost no weather.
misconceptions.zh: 云主要在很薄的对流层中，上方仍有大气，但常见天气很少。

misconceptions.key: The troposphere is about half the stack.
misconceptions.zh: 对流层占大气展示的一半厚度。

misconceptions.key: On a fair drawing it is a film. School shells are exploded so you can name them, not so you can measure thickness from the poster.
misconceptions.zh: 按地球真实尺度看，对流层很薄；展开图用于辨认，不能直接量厚度。

misconceptions.key: We run out of air at the tropopause, so Denver is halfway to space.
misconceptions.zh: 到对流层顶空气就用完了，丹佛已走完一半太空路程。

misconceptions.key: Pressure falls with height, but air continues. Denver at about 1.6 km is still deep in a 10–12 km troposphere.
misconceptions.zh: 气压随高度下降，但空气继续存在。约 1.6 km 的丹佛仍在对流层深处。

objective.key: Trace incoming shortwave, albedo, longwave from the ground, and a simple greenhouse return.
objective.zh: 追踪入射短波、反照、地表长波辐射和简化的温室回辐射。

why.key: Earth intercepts sunlight over a disc and radiates over a sphere. Averaging 1361 W/m² over the globe gives 340.25 W/m² before reflection. Planetary albedo is the fraction reflected by the atmosphere, clouds and surface together. Absorbed sunlight is incoming sunlight times one minus albedo.
why.zh: 地球以圆盘截获阳光，以球面向外辐射。将 1361 W/m² 平均到全球表面，反射前为 340.25 W/m²。行星反照率包含大气、云和地表共同反射的比例；吸收量等于入射量乘以一减反照率。

why.key: The experiment treats the surface as a blackbody and the atmosphere as one grey layer that is transparent to sunlight. With Greenhouse on, infrared absorptivity and emissivity are both 0.78. The layer emits upward and downward. Surface emission is σT⁴; upward radiation reaching space is the atmospheric emission plus the portion of surface emission transmitted through the layer.
why.zh: 实验将地表视为黑体、大气视为对太阳光透明的一层灰体。开启温室作用时，大气红外吸收率和发射率均为 0.78，并向上、向下辐射。地表发射遵循 σT⁴；抵达太空的长波由大气向上发射与透过大气的地表辐射组成。

why.key: Change Albedo and read absorbed sunlight, surface emission and equilibrium temperature. Turn Greenhouse off: the same absorbed sunlight balances a cooler surface directly. With the layer on, back radiation lets the surface be warmer while outgoing longwave still balances absorbed sunlight at the top of the atmosphere. Play animates flux tracers; it does not simulate a temperature transient.
why.zh: 改变反照率，读取吸收太阳能、地表发射和平衡温度。关闭温室层后，同样吸收量直接与较冷地表的发射平衡。开启时，下行长波使地表更暖，但大气层顶向外长波仍与吸收太阳能平衡。播放只移动通量示踪点，不计算温度随时间变化。

why.key: This radiative experiment omits atmospheric absorption of sunlight, convection, evaporation, clouds as separate layers and wavelength dependence. Its temperature is not a local weather reading or a calibrated climate projection. The arrows show energy flows in W/m²; their positions do not represent atmospheric heights.
why.zh: 模型省略大气对短波的吸收、对流、蒸发、分层云和波长依赖。温度不是局地天气值，也不是校准后的气候预测。箭头表示 W/m² 的能量通量，其位置不代表实际高度。

steps.key: Explain why solar irradiance is divided by four. Use albedo 0.3 and turn Greenhouse off. Read the surface temperature.
steps.zh: 解释太阳辐照度为何除以四。将反照率设为 0.3、关闭温室效应，读取地表温度。

steps.key: Turn Greenhouse on; distinguish surface emission from outgoing radiation at the top of the atmosphere. Check the top-of-atmosphere balance.
steps.zh: 开启温室效应，区分地表辐射与大气顶向外辐射，并核对大气顶能量平衡。

steps.key: Increase albedo while keeping infrared absorption fixed. Name one process this model leaves out, then finish in Check.
steps.zh: 固定红外吸收、提高反照率。指出模型未包含的一种过程，再完成自测。

steps.key: 4 questions with explanations. Give a reason for each choice; there is no score gate.
steps.zh: 4 道题，附解析。请说明选择理由。

script.key:
Explain why solar irradiance is divided by four.
Use albedo 0.3 and turn Greenhouse off. Read the surface temperature.
Turn Greenhouse on; distinguish surface emission from outgoing radiation at the top of the atmosphere.
Check the top-of-atmosphere balance.
Increase albedo while keeping infrared absorption fixed.
Name one process this model leaves out, then finish in Check.
script.zh:
解释太阳辐照度为何除以四。将反照率设为 0.3、关闭温室效应，读取地表温度。
开启温室效应，区分地表辐射与大气顶向外辐射，并核对大气顶能量平衡。
固定红外吸收、提高反照率。指出模型未包含的一种过程，再完成自测。
最后完成自测，请学生说明判断依据。

pitfalls.key: Calling this a climate prediction.
pitfalls.zh: 把单层模型称为气候预测。

pitfalls.key: ‘The atmosphere is a blanket that blocks sunlight.’
pitfalls.zh: 把大气比作只阻挡阳光的毯子。

pitfalls.key: Inventing watt-per-square-metre inventories the lab does not show.
pitfalls.zh: 添加模型未显示的假定通量清单。

pitfalls.key: Teaching albedo as a feeling of warmth rather than a reflected fraction.
pitfalls.zh: 把反照率当成温热感觉。

misconceptions.key: The air takes the Sun’s heat, then warms the ground.
misconceptions.zh: 空气先接收全部太阳热量，再加热地面。

misconceptions.key: The ground (and ocean) take most of the beam. The air is heated from below, plus some absorption.
misconceptions.zh: 地表和海洋吸收大量太阳能，大气既有直接吸收，也受到地表向上的能量传递。

misconceptions.key: Greenhouse gases trap the Sun’s yellow light as a blanket over the beam.
misconceptions.zh: 温室气体主要困住太阳黄色光。

misconceptions.key: The solar beam is shortwave. Greenhouse return is longwave from the atmosphere back to the ground.
misconceptions.zh: 太阳入射主要是短波，温室作用涉及地表与大气之间的长波吸收和发射。

misconceptions.key: Albedo is how hot a surface feels to the hand.
misconceptions.zh: 反照率是摸起来有多热。

misconceptions.key: Albedo is the reflected fraction of shortwave. A dark dry pavement can run hot because it absorbs more, then emits longwave.
misconceptions.zh: 反照率是反射比例；深色地表常吸收较多短波，但实际温度还受其他能量过程影响。

objective.key: Heat one column, watch the loop, and switch between land–sea breeze and a simple urban-heat island.
objective.zh: 加热一侧空气柱，观察环流，并切换海陆风与简化城市热岛。

why.key: Uneven heating can drive a local circulation. In this coastal experiment, land warms more during the afternoon and cools more at night than the sea. A surface pressure difference draws air towards the warmer side, with ascent there and return flow aloft.
why.zh: 不均匀加热可驱动局地环流。本实验中陆地午后升温较多，夜间冷却较快；近地面气压差推动空气流向较暖一侧，在该处上升并在高空返回。

why.key: Land–sea prescribes an afternoon-to-night thermal contrast. Urban heat instead compares a warmer city with rural surroundings; it takes priority if both settings are on. Turn both off for equal heating and no loop. Temperatures and flow speed are illustrative inputs, not a simulated surface-energy budget.
why.zh: 海陆模式指定午后至夜间的温差，城市热岛模式则比较较暖城市与乡村；同时开启时城市模式优先。都关闭则等温、无环流。温度与速度是说明性输入，不是求解地表能量收支所得。

why.key: Play or scrub Day to compare afternoon and night. Name the direction of the surface branch before reading the labels. With Urban heat, discuss stored heat and reduced evaporative cooling. The displayed loop is enlarged vertically fourfold; T restores the conceptual domain’s 20 km width and 2 km depth. Trees and buildings remain enlarged markers.
why.zh: 播放或拖动一天进程，先判断地面风向，再核对标签。城市模式可讨论储热与蒸发冷却减少。环流默认垂直放大 4 倍，T 恢复概念区域 20 km 宽、2 km 深的比例；树木与建筑仍是放大标记。

why.key: A real sea breeze depends on background wind, clouds, moisture, topography and the Earth’s rotation. A night-time reversal is possible, not guaranteed. Rotation is omitted here to isolate thermal forcing, not because Coriolis vanishes at a particular distance. Use the photo and temperature readout to explain the contrast if the canvas is unavailable.
why.zh: 真实海风受背景风、云、湿度、地形和地球自转影响，夜间可能反向但不保证。这里忽略自转是为单独观察热力强迫，不能据此认为局地科里奥利作用严格为零。

steps.key: Compare sea and land at local hour 15. Trace surface inflow towards the warmer land and return flow aloft.
steps.zh: 在当地 15 时比较海洋与陆地，追踪近地面流向较暖陆地的气流及上空返回气流。

steps.key: Scrub to hour 3 and identify the possible reversal. Select Urban heat and compare city with rural surroundings.
steps.zh: 拖到 3 时辨认可能的反转；选择城市热岛，比较城市与乡村。

steps.key: Turn both settings off; equal heating removes this thermal loop. Name the omitted processes before Check.
steps.zh: 关闭两种差异加热设置，观察热力环流消失。说明模型省略的过程，再自测。

steps.key: 4 questions with explanations. Give a reason for each choice; there is no score gate.
steps.zh: 4 道题，附解析。请说明选择理由。

script.key:
Compare sea and land at local hour 15.
Trace surface inflow towards the warmer land and return flow aloft.
Scrub to hour 3 and identify the possible reversal.
Select Urban heat and compare city with rural surroundings.
Turn both settings off; equal heating removes this thermal loop.
Name the omitted processes before Check.
script.zh:
在当地 15 时比较海洋与陆地，追踪近地面流向较暖陆地的气流及上空返回气流。
拖到 3 时辨认可能的反转；选择城市热岛，比较城市与乡村。
关闭两种差异加热设置，观察热力环流消失。说明模型省略的过程，再自测。
最后完成自测，请学生说明判断依据。

pitfalls.key: Treating prescribed temperatures as observations.
pitfalls.zh: 把指定温度当作观测。

pitfalls.key: Promising a land breeze every night.
pitfalls.zh: 保证每晚都会出现陆风。

pitfalls.key: Claiming that Coriolis is zero on local scales.
pitfalls.zh: 宣称科里奥利作用在局地严格为零。

misconceptions.key: Wind starts because the sea is always cold.
misconceptions.zh: 风是因为海洋永远很冷。

misconceptions.key: It starts because heating is uneven. The sea’s slower temperature change is the contrast, not a permanent cold machine.
misconceptions.zh: 关键是不均匀加热，海温变化较慢，而非海洋永久制冷。

misconceptions.key: Every coastal wind is a monsoon.
misconceptions.zh: 每一种沿海风都是季风。

misconceptions.key: A sea breeze is a local thermal loop, kilometres not ocean basins. Monsoon is a seasonal, much larger reversal.
misconceptions.zh: 海风是局地日变化环流；季风涉及更大范围的季节性变化。

misconceptions.key: Cities are warmer only because of car exhaust.
misconceptions.zh: 城市更暖只因为汽车尾气。

misconceptions.key: Surface materials, geometry, and less evaporative cooling do most of the school-level work, especially at night.
misconceptions.zh: 表面材料、城市几何、储热和较少蒸发冷却都很重要，尤其在夜间。

title.zh: 风、气压梯度与科里奥利力

objective.key: Name PGF, switch Coriolis on, compare NH and SH, and add friction near the surface.
objective.zh: 辨认气压梯度力，开启科里奥利效应，比较南北半球，并加入近地面摩擦。

why.key: Air accelerates towards lower pressure under the pressure-gradient force. In a rotating reference frame, moving air also experiences Coriolis acceleration: to the right of its motion in the Northern Hemisphere and to the left in the Southern Hemisphere. Coriolis changes direction but does no work on the flow.
why.zh: 气压梯度力使空气向低压加速。在旋转参考系中，运动空气还受科里奥利加速度：北半球向运动右侧，南半球向左。科里奥利作用改变方向，但不对气流做功。

why.key: Gold, blue and coral arrows use the same acceleration scale for pressure gradient, Coriolis and friction. White is wind velocity on a separate scale. The fixed northward pressure-gradient acceleration is 0.001 m/s². Coriolis parameter f is ±0.0001 s⁻¹; surface friction uses a linear drag coefficient of 0.00005 s⁻¹. Parallel lines are isobars on a flat f plane.
why.zh: 金、蓝、珊瑚色箭头用同一加速度比例表示气压梯度、科里奥利和摩擦；白色速度箭头采用另一比例。向北气压梯度加速度固定为 0.001 m/s²，科里奥利参数 f 为 ±0.0001 s⁻¹，线性阻力系数为 0.00005 s⁻¹。平行线是平面 f 模型中的等压线。

why.key: Start at steady balance. With Coriolis alone, wind is parallel to the isobars. Reverse hemisphere, then add friction: the wind slows and crosses towards lower pressure. Select Release from rest and Play or scrub Process to see the first 24 hours. The faint white curve traces velocity endpoints, not a parcel trajectory. Without friction, motion oscillates about the geostrophic wind; it does not simply settle. With neither force, the fixed gradient keeps accelerating the air.
why.zh: 先看稳态：仅有科里奥利与气压梯度平衡时，风平行等压线。反转半球并加入摩擦，风减速并跨等压线流向低压。从静止释放后可播放前 24 小时；淡色曲线连接速度端点，不是空气粒子轨迹。无摩擦时围绕地转风振荡，并不会自行稳定。

why.key: This is a constant-gradient, constant-f experiment. It excludes changing pressure fields, curved flow, turbulence and vertical motion. The force balance cannot be applied unchanged near the equator or inside a tornado. Use the arrow colours and readout if WebGL is unavailable, then explain why a velocity arrow is not a force.
why.zh: 恒定气压梯度和 f 模型不包含变化天气场、曲线运动、湍流与垂直运动。不能原样应用于赤道附近或龙卷风内部。分析时必须区分速度箭头与加速度箭头。

steps.key: Identify the lower-pressure side and predict the pressure-gradient arrow. Compare north and south hemispheres at steady balance.
steps.zh: 辨认低压一侧，预测气压梯度力方向。比较南北半球的稳定平衡。

steps.key: Add friction and describe the cross-isobar component. Select Release from rest and scrub Process.
steps.zh: 加入摩擦，描述风跨越等压线的分量。选择从静止释放，并拖动进程。

steps.key: Remove Coriolis and friction to distinguish steady balance from acceleration.
steps.zh: 去掉科里奥利作用和摩擦，区分稳定平衡与持续加速。

steps.key: 4 questions with explanations. Give a reason for each choice; there is no score gate.
steps.zh: 4 道题，附解析。请说明选择理由。

script.key:
Identify the lower-pressure side and predict the pressure-gradient arrow.
Compare north and south hemispheres at steady balance.
Add friction and describe the cross-isobar component.
Select Release from rest and scrub Process.
Remove Coriolis and friction to distinguish steady balance from acceleration.
Finish in Check.
script.zh:
辨认低压一侧，预测气压梯度力方向。比较南北半球的稳定平衡。
加入摩擦，描述风跨越等压线的分量。选择从静止释放，并拖动进程。
去掉科里奥利作用和摩擦，区分稳定平衡与持续加速。
最后完成自测，请学生说明判断依据。

pitfalls.key: Coriolis as a real force you can point at in the room.
pitfalls.zh: 把科里奥利效应当作某个实体直接施力。

pitfalls.key: NH vs SH mix-up.
pitfalls.zh: 混淆南北半球偏转。

pitfalls.key: Sinks and toilets as evidence.
pitfalls.zh: 用水槽或厕所旋流证明半球差异。

pitfalls.key: Teaching friction as something that speeds the wind.
pitfalls.zh: 说摩擦会使风加速。

misconceptions.key: Coriolis makes water swirl in a sink.
misconceptions.zh: 水槽漩涡主要证明科里奥利作用。

misconceptions.key: Basin scale is too small. Weather systems are large enough. Sinks are not.
misconceptions.zh: 水槽太小，初始流动和容器条件占主导，不能用来判断半球。

misconceptions.key: Coriolis is a real force you can point at in the room.
misconceptions.zh: 科里奥利力是空气中某个物体直接施加的推力。

misconceptions.key: It is an apparent deflection because we measure on a rotating Earth. You cannot hang a label on a bit of air and call it Coriolis.
misconceptions.zh: 它是旋转参考系中的惯性效应，用于描述相对转动地球观察到的偏转。

misconceptions.key: Friction makes the wind faster.
misconceptions.zh: 摩擦使风更快。

misconceptions.key: Friction slows the wind. Weaker Coriolis then lets PGF pull the surface flow across isobars toward low.
misconceptions.zh: 摩擦通常使风减速，科里奥利作用随之减弱，使近地面风跨等压线趋向低压。

objective.key: Toggle 1-cell vs 3-cell, name Hadley / Ferrel / Polar, and watch the ITCZ walk with the seasons.
objective.zh: 比较单圈与三圈环流，辨认哈德莱、费雷尔和极地环流，观察热带辐合带的季节移动。

why.key: The three-cell picture summarises the atmosphere after averaging weather and longitude. Hadley circulation rises near the tropical convergence zone, moves poleward aloft and sinks in the subtropics. Polar circulation is another thermally direct cell; the Ferrel cell is thermally indirect.
why.zh: 三圈环流是大气经过时间和经度平均后的概括。哈德莱环流在热带辐合区附近上升，高空向极、在副热带下沉；极地环流也属热力直接环流，费雷尔环流则是热力间接环流。

why.key: Midlatitude eddies transport heat and momentum and help maintain the mean Ferrel circulation. Real parcels follow evolving storms and jets, not permanent textbook pipes. Rotation matters, but saying Coriolis simply splits one loop into three leaves out these eddies and the atmosphere’s energy and momentum balances.
why.zh: 中纬度天气涡旋输送热量和动量，帮助维持平均费雷尔环流。真实空气随风暴和急流运动，并不沿固定管道循环。自转重要，但只说科里奥利把单圈切成三圈，会漏掉涡旋及能量、动量平衡。

why.key: Toggle Three cells to compare a hypothetical non-rotating single cell. In the three-cell view, follow the lower branches and surface arrows: tropical and polar easterlies, midlatitude westerlies. Play a year to move a prescribed ITCZ between 10° S and 10° N. This is an illustration, not a formula for its real position. T reduces the displayed cell depth to 12 km against a 6371 km Earth radius.
why.zh: 切换三圈与假想无自转单圈，追踪低层分支：热带和极地偏东风、中纬度偏西风。播放一年时，指定的 ITCZ 在南北纬 10° 间移动，这不是其真实位置公式。T 将显示深度恢复为相对 6371 km 地球半径的 12 km。

why.key: Cell edges, depths and the ITCZ vary with season, longitude, land and ocean. The ITCZ is not fixed to the geographic equator and does not track the subsolar latitude exactly. A Florida wet season cannot be attributed simply to this line passing overhead. Use the source and real cloud photograph to discuss the limitations before Check.
why.zh: 环流边缘、深度和 ITCZ 随季节、经度及海陆分布改变。ITCZ 不固定在赤道，也不精确跟随太阳直射纬度；不能把佛罗里达湿季简单归因为这条线经过。

steps.key: Identify Hadley, Ferrel and Polar in the zonal-mean view. Follow near-surface easterlies and westerlies.
steps.zh: 在纬向平均视图中辨认哈德莱、费雷尔和极地环流，追踪近地面的东风与西风。

steps.key: Distinguish the eddy-driven Ferrel circulation from a thermally direct cell. Play the illustrative annual shift; explain why real ITCZ positions differ.
steps.zh: 区分由天气扰动维持的费雷尔环流与热力直接环流。播放示意性年变化，说明真实 ITCZ 为何更复杂。

steps.key: Press T to compare atmospheric depth with Earth’s radius.
steps.zh: 按 T 比较大气厚度与地球半径。

steps.key: 4 questions with explanations. Give a reason for each choice; there is no score gate.
steps.zh: 4 道题，附解析。请说明选择理由。

script.key:
Identify Hadley, Ferrel and Polar in the zonal-mean view.
Follow near-surface easterlies and westerlies.
Distinguish the eddy-driven Ferrel circulation from a thermally direct cell.
Play the illustrative annual shift; explain why real ITCZ positions differ.
Press T to compare atmospheric depth with Earth’s radius.
Finish in Check.
script.zh:
在纬向平均视图中辨认哈德莱、费雷尔和极地环流，追踪近地面的东风与西风。
区分由天气扰动维持的费雷尔环流与热力直接环流。播放示意性年变化，说明真实 ITCZ 为何更复杂。
按 T 比较大气厚度与地球半径。
最后完成自测，请学生说明判断依据。

pitfalls.key: Drawing three equal cells.
pitfalls.zh: 画三个完全相同的环流圈。

pitfalls.key: Putting the UK in the Hadley cell.
pitfalls.zh: 把英国放进哈德莱环流。

pitfalls.key: Teaching the ITCZ as a painted line on the equator.
pitfalls.zh: 把 ITCZ 画成固定赤道线。

pitfalls.key: Selling Ferrel as a clean thermally direct loop.
pitfalls.zh: 把费雷尔环流说成简单热力直接循环。

misconceptions.key: The equator is always the wettest place, fixed.
misconceptions.zh: 赤道永远是固定的最湿地点。

misconceptions.key: The rain follows the ITCZ, which walks with the seasons.
misconceptions.zh: 降水与随季节移动的辐合带及其他地区过程有关。

misconceptions.key: The UK sits in the Hadley cell.
misconceptions.zh: 英国位于哈德莱环流中。

misconceptions.key: Hadley is tropical. The UK’s westerlies live in the midlatitude Ferrel story, storm tracks included.
misconceptions.zh: 英国的西风与中纬度天气活动更相关，属于费雷尔平均环流背景。

misconceptions.key: The three cells are equal in size and equally clean.
misconceptions.zh: 三个环流圈同样大小、同样规则。

misconceptions.key: Hadley is the big thermally direct loop. Ferrel is indirect and stormy. Do not draw three matching doughnuts.
misconceptions.zh: 哈德莱是热力直接环流，费雷尔为受天气涡旋维持的间接环流，不能画成三个等大的圆环。

objective.key: Distinguish warm, cold, and occluded fronts as 3D wedges with cloud and rain symbols.
objective.zh: 利用三维楔形结构和云雨标记，区分暖锋、冷锋与锢囚锋。

why.key: A front separates air masses. The line on a surface weather chart is the boundary’s ground trace; above it, the boundary slopes. In this cross-section, colder air advances from the left and warmer air overruns cool air to the right.
why.zh: 锋面分隔不同气团。地面天气图上的线是它与地面的交线，边界向高空倾斜。本剖面中更冷空气从左推进，暖空气在右侧较凉空气上方爬升。

why.key: The experiment prescribes a cold-front slope of 1:50 and a gentler warm-front slope of 1:150 across 600 km. Vertical dimensions are enlarged twentyfold until T is pressed. Cold air, cool air ahead and the warm layer occupy separate volumes. Coloured transparent volumes identify air masses; they are not solid walls.
why.zh: 实验指定冷锋坡度 1:50、暖锋更缓为 1:150，横跨 600 km。默认垂直放大 20 倍，T 恢复同一比例。冷空气、前方凉空气和暖层占据不同体积；透明色用于辨认，不表示固体墙。

why.key: Play or scrub Process as the faster cold front narrows the surface warm sector. At 70% progress it catches the warm front. Thereafter the colder air undercuts the cool air and the warm layer is lifted off the surface: an ideal cold-type occlusion. The readout gives the minimum height of that warm layer at the meeting point.
why.zh: 播放过程，较快冷锋使地面暖区逐渐缩窄。进度 70% 时追上暖锋，随后较冷空气插入凉空气下方，暖层被抬离地面，形成理想冷式锢囚。读数显示交会处暖层最低高度。

why.key: Warm-type occlusions and real three-dimensional cyclone structures are more varied. Frontal ascent may form cloud and precipitation if moisture and stability allow it; the cloud symbols are illustrative, not a forecast or calculated condensation level. Use the cross-section and the source weather chart to explain what a surface line leaves out.
why.zh: 暖式锢囚和真实三维气旋更复杂。锋面抬升是否形成云雨取决于水汽和稳定度；云只是说明符号，不是预报或计算的凝结高度。请结合剖面理解地面锋线省略的信息。

steps.key: Identify cold air, the warm sector and cool air ahead. Compare the two prescribed slopes.
steps.zh: 辨认冷空气、暖区和前方凉空气，比较两种设定的锋面坡度。

steps.key: Scrub Process to 0.70, where the surface warm sector closes. Continue and locate warm air above the meeting point.
steps.zh: 把进程拖到 0.70，观察地面暖区闭合；继续前进，找到交汇上方的暖空气。

steps.key: Press T to see equal horizontal and vertical scales. Explain why a chart line has no width but a real frontal zone does. Finish in Check.
steps.zh: 按 T 恢复横纵相同比例。说明图上的锋线与现实中具有宽度的锋区的区别，再自测。

steps.key: 4 questions with explanations. Give a reason for each choice; there is no score gate.
steps.zh: 4 道题，附解析。请说明选择理由。

script.key:
Identify cold air, the warm sector and cool air ahead.
Compare the two prescribed slopes.
Scrub Process to 0.70, where the surface warm sector closes.
Continue and locate warm air above the meeting point.
Press T to see equal horizontal and vertical scales.
Explain why a chart line has no width but a real frontal zone does. Finish in Check.
script.zh:
辨认冷空气、暖区和前方凉空气，比较两种设定的锋面坡度。
把进程拖到 0.70，观察地面暖区闭合；继续前进，找到交汇上方的暖空气。
按 T 恢复横纵相同比例。说明图上的锋线与现实中具有宽度的锋区的区别，再自测。
最后完成自测，请学生说明判断依据。

pitfalls.key: Teaching fronts only as symbols.
pitfalls.zh: 只教锋面符号，不讲立体结构。

pitfalls.key: Calling every UK rainband a hurricane.
pitfalls.zh: 把每条英国雨带称为飓风。

pitfalls.key: Drawing a cold front as a vertical wall.
pitfalls.zh: 把冷锋画成垂直墙。

pitfalls.key: Putting all the weather on the map line instead of on the slope.
pitfalls.zh: 把所有云雨都放在地面锋线上。

misconceptions.key: A front is a painted line.
misconceptions.zh: 锋只是画在地图上的一条线。

misconceptions.key: The line is where the wedge meets the ground. The weather is on the slope.
misconceptions.zh: 锋线是倾斜气团边界与地面的交线。

misconceptions.key: A cold front is a vertical wall of cold.
misconceptions.zh: 冷锋是一堵垂直冷空气墙。

misconceptions.key: It is a steep wedge. Dense air undercuts. Rain sits on the slope, often narrow and showery.
misconceptions.zh: 较密冷空气形成有坡度的楔体，在暖空气下方推进。

misconceptions.key: Every UK rainband is a hurricane.
misconceptions.zh: 英国每条雨带都是飓风。

misconceptions.key: A midlatitude front is a different machine from a tropical eyewall. Share the wedge idea, not the violence.
misconceptions.zh: 中纬度锋面与热带气旋眼墙属于不同结构和机制。

objective.key: Contrast a NH cyclone (anticlockwise, low) with an anticyclone (clockwise, high), and attach fronts to the low.
objective.zh: 比较北半球逆时针低压气旋与顺时针高压反气旋，并观察低压系统的锋面。

why.key: A cyclone is a low-pressure circulation; an anticyclone surrounds a high. Extratropical cyclones often have fronts separating air masses. Tropical cyclones have a different warm-core structure; the word cyclone alone does not mean hurricane.
why.zh: 气旋是围绕低压的环流，反气旋围绕高压。温带气旋常有分隔气团的锋面，热带气旋则具有不同的暖心结构；气旋不等于飓风。

why.key: Near the surface, friction allows convergence towards a low and divergence away from a high. Coriolis changes rotation with hemisphere. Viewed from above, a Northern Hemisphere low turns anticlockwise and a high clockwise; both directions reverse in the Southern Hemisphere. The low’s inflow feeds ascent; the high’s outflow is supplied by descent.
why.zh: 近地面摩擦使空气可向低压辐合、从高压辐散。俯视北半球，低压逆时针、高压顺时针，南半球相反。低压流入与上升相联系，高压流出由下沉补充。

why.key: Toggle Anticyclone and Southern hemisphere separately. Play follows illustrative surface paths. The rings are conceptual isobars, without assigned pressure or wind speed. Blue and coral lines are example cold- and warm-front traces on an extratropical low. They stay fixed: fronts are not rigid spokes carried round by every air parcel. Open Fronts for the sloping boundaries.
why.zh: 分别切换反气旋与南半球。播放沿说明性地面路径移动粒子。圆环是未赋具体数值的等压线；蓝色与珊瑚色线是温带低压的冷暖锋示例，保持固定，因为锋面并非随每个气块转动的刚性辐条。

why.key: The kinematic paths demonstrate circulation direction, not a numerical weather forecast. Subsidence often reduces deep cloud, but fog and low stratus can persist under high pressure. Rising air does not automatically produce rain without sufficient moisture. Read the labels and inspect a weather chart if the canvas is unavailable.
why.zh: 这些运动路径只解释环流方向，不是天气预报。下沉常抑制深云，但高压下仍可能有雾和低层云；空气上升也需足够水汽才可能降雨。

steps.key: Identify the low and trace surface convergence. Read spin from above, then reverse hemisphere.
steps.zh: 辨认低压和地面辐合，从上方读出旋转方向，再切换半球。

steps.key: Switch to Anticyclone and distinguish divergence from rotation. Name the exaggerated vertical motion.
steps.zh: 切到反气旋，区分辐散与旋转方向，并指出被夸张的垂直运动。

steps.key: Locate the example fronts on the low and compare with the Fronts lab.
steps.zh: 找出低压附近的示例锋面，与锋面实验比较。

steps.key: 4 questions with explanations. Give a reason for each choice; there is no score gate.
steps.zh: 4 道题，附解析。请说明选择理由。

script.key:
Identify the low and trace surface convergence.
Read spin from above, then reverse hemisphere.
Switch to Anticyclone and distinguish divergence from rotation.
Name the exaggerated vertical motion.
Locate the example fronts on the low and compare with the Fronts lab.
Finish in Check.
script.zh:
辨认低压和地面辐合，从上方读出旋转方向，再切换半球。
切到反气旋，区分辐散与旋转方向，并指出被夸张的垂直运动。
找出低压附近的示例锋面，与锋面实验比较。
最后完成自测，请学生说明判断依据。

pitfalls.key: NH/SH spin mix-up.
pitfalls.zh: 混淆南北半球旋转方向。

pitfalls.key: One word ‘cyclone’ for two machines.
pitfalls.zh: 将所有气旋视为同一结构。

pitfalls.key: Promising sunshine under every anticyclone.
pitfalls.zh: 保证每个反气旋都晴朗。

pitfalls.key: Calling a UK gale a hurricane without the Met Office.
pitfalls.zh: 把普通英国大风称为飓风。

misconceptions.key: Cyclone means hurricane.
misconceptions.zh: 气旋就是飓风。

misconceptions.key: Cyclone is the family. Tropical cyclone is one member. Midlatitude depressions are another.
misconceptions.zh: 气旋是更广的概念，热带气旋与中纬度低压是不同成员。

misconceptions.key: High pressure always means sunshine.
misconceptions.zh: 高压一定带来晴天。

misconceptions.key: Sink, compress, warm, dry: often clearer. A British winter anticyclone can still sit fog and stratus under the lid.
misconceptions.zh: 下沉常利于少云，但冬季反气旋下仍可有雾和层云。

misconceptions.key: Northern- and southern-hemisphere cyclones spin the same way.
misconceptions.zh: 南北半球气旋旋转方向相同。

misconceptions.key: NH cyclone anticlockwise, SH cyclone clockwise. Flip the hemisphere and the diagram must flip.
misconceptions.zh: 北半球低压逆时针，南半球低压顺时针，均从上方观察。

objective.key: Locate Köppen–Geiger families A–E and distinguish climate classification, local vegetation and daily weather.
objective.zh: 定位柯本–盖格 A–E 气候大类，区分气候分类、当地植被与每日天气。

why.key: Köppen–Geiger classification uses long-term monthly temperature and precipitation patterns. The five broad families are A tropical, B dry, C temperate, D cold continental and E polar. Subclasses distinguish moisture seasonality and temperature ranges. B is determined using an empirical aridity threshold; it is not simply another temperature band and can include hot or cold climates.
why.zh: 柯本—盖格分类使用长期月平均温度和降水。五大类为 A 热带、B 干旱、C 温带、D 冷温带大陆性、E 极地，亚类再区分水分季节性与温度。B 使用经验干旱阈值，可包含炎热或寒冷环境，并非单纯温度带。

why.key: The globe uses Beck et al. V3 classification for 1991–2020, grouping the official 0.1° grid into five families. It is a classified scientific dataset, not a photograph, vegetation survey or current weather layer. Selecting a family highlights its cells. Coastlines and boundaries are generalised; a different period, grid, dataset or classification convention can move a boundary.
why.zh: 球体使用 Beck 等 V3 的 1991–2020 分类，将官方 0.1° 网格归为五大类。这是科学分类数据，不是照片、植被调查或实时天气。选择某类可高亮相应网格；时期、分辨率或分类约定改变，都可能使边界变化。

why.key: Reference examples are Singapore Af, Cairo BWh, London Cfb, Helsinki Dfb and a Nuuk ET cell. The first four reference values come from the Atlas 1 km raster; Nuuk is sampled from the official 0.1° grid used for the globe. A point classification never describes an entire country. Cfb denotes temperate conditions without a dry season and with warm summers; one unusually hot week does not change that long-term category.
why.zh: 参考点为新加坡 Af、开罗 BWh、伦敦 Cfb、赫尔辛基 Dfb 和努克 ET。前四点来自 Atlas 的 1 km 栅格，努克来自球体使用的官方 0.1° 网格。单点不能代表整个国家。Cfb 表示无干季、夏季温暖的温带气候，一周异常炎热不会改变长期类别。

why.key: The separate 60 by 44 m biome model is an illustrative association, not a reconstruction of the reference place. A includes rainforest, monsoon and savannah climates; B includes desert and steppe; C and D support several kinds of vegetation and land use. E includes ET tundra and EF ice cap, and the selected tundra example illustrates ET; it is not surveyed vegetation at Nuuk. Soil, fire, elevation, human activity and ecological history also shape vegetation. Climate classification does not predict next Tuesday or the future condition of a particular field.
why.zh: 独立的 60 × 44 m 生物群系模型只是关联示例，并非参考地点的重建。A 可含雨林、季风林和稀树草原，B 可含沙漠与草原，C、D 支持多种植被及土地利用。E 包含 ET 苔原与 EF 冰原；苔原示例不是努克植被实测。土壤、火、海拔、人类活动和生态历史也影响植被。

steps.key: Read the A–E legend and identify the highlighted family on the globe.
steps.zh: 阅读 A–E 图例，找出地球上被高亮的气候大类。

steps.key: Change family; compare its geographical distribution and a possible biome.
steps.zh: 切换气候大类，比较地理分布和可能的生物群系。

steps.key: Separate long-term climate, actual land cover and weather at the reference point.
steps.zh: 区分长期气候、实际地表覆盖与参考点当天的天气。

steps.key: 4 questions with explanations. Give a reason for each choice; there is no score gate.
steps.zh: 4 道题，附解析。请说明选择理由。

script.key:
Read the dataset period and the five-family legend.
Choose tropical, then dry; discuss rainfall as well as temperature.
Locate London Cfb and distinguish its point value from the whole UK.
Choose polar; locate Nuuk ET and distinguish tundra from EF ice-cap climate.
Ask why current land cover can differ from an expected biome.
Finish in Check.
script.zh:
阅读 A–E 图例，找出地球上被高亮的气候大类。
切换气候大类，比较地理分布和可能的生物群系。
区分长期气候、实际地表覆盖与参考点当天的天气。
最后完成自测，请学生说明判断依据。

pitfalls.key: Calling classified cells current weather.
pitfalls.zh: 把分类网格称为实时天气。

pitfalls.key: Giving a whole country its capital’s class.
pitfalls.zh: 用首都类别代表整个国家。

pitfalls.key: Equating every climate family with exactly one biome.
pitfalls.zh: 让每个气候大类只对应一种生物群系。

misconceptions.key: Climate is the weather this week.
misconceptions.zh: 气候就是本周天气。

misconceptions.key: Climate describes longer-term distributions and patterns; Köppen–Geiger uses monthly temperature and precipitation statistics.
misconceptions.zh: 气候描述较长期的分布与规律，柯本分类使用月温度和降水统计。

misconceptions.key: One hot summer makes London tropical.
misconceptions.zh: 一个炎热夏天就使伦敦变为热带。

misconceptions.key: The Cfb reference describes a specified grid cell and averaging period, not a single hot week.
misconceptions.zh: Cfb 描述指定网格与平均时期，不是某次高温周。

misconceptions.key: Every mapped boundary is a visible line on the ground.
misconceptions.zh: 分类边界都能在地面上看见一条线。

misconceptions.key: Class thresholds produce discrete map boundaries. Terrain, grid resolution and gradual environmental transitions complicate their interpretation.
misconceptions.zh: 离散阈值产生地图边界，真实环境常渐变且受地形与分辨率影响。

objective.key: Trace a watershed and name source, tributary, confluence, and mouth as stations on one basin, not four separate rivers.
objective.zh: 追踪分水岭，辨认同一流域的源头、支流、汇流点与河口。

why.key: The Thames and the Mississippi are the same diagram at different size. A GCSE class that can name source, tributary, confluence and mouth on a Thames tributary tree can read the Mississippi without a new theory. The Severn and the Thames share a divide: rain on one side is this river, rain on the other is someone else’s. Colorado’s basin is the same rim at a drier number — dams and abstraction sit inside a watershed, they do not redraw it. Flood warnings, water-company licences, and a school fieldwork sheet all start with one question: which hillside drains here? The basin is the collecting surface, not the blue line on the OS sheet. US counties and UK Environment Agency catchments are administrative names laid on this physical machine. Holderness is a different coast; this lab is the inland bowl that feeds a river to a mouth.
why.zh: 流域是向同一河流系统排水的陆地区域。泰晤士河、密西西比河和小山溪尺度不同，但源头、支流、汇流点与出口这些关系相同。分析洪水和取水之前，先确定哪些坡面汇入这里。

why.key: A drainage basin is the area of land drained by a river and its tributaries, bounded by a watershed — the drainage divide. Precipitation that falls inside the rim becomes this river’s budget; the other side belongs to a neighbour. Source is where channelised flow begins, often a spring or a gathering of rills. A tributary is a joining stream. A confluence is where they meet. The mouth is where the river exits to sea, lake, or a larger river, and it is not always a delta. The channel is only the drain. Hillsides, soils, floodplain and channel together are the basin. Overlay on: the rim lights as a line you can trace. Overlay off: you still have to point at it on the hill. Vertical exaggeration is labelled ×8 so the bowl reads from the back of the room; a real Thames divide can be a low ridge or a field boundary, not a crater rim. Size is not type. Stations stay the same from a Lake District beck to the Mississippi. Rain on one side of the rim is this river. Rain on the other is someone else’s. Do not confuse the watershed with a building. Do not teach the blue OS line as the whole catchment.
why.zh: 源头是河道集中流动开始的位置，支流汇入干流，交会处为汇流点，河口通向海、湖或更大河流。坡面、土壤、洪泛平原和河道共同构成流域。分水岭可很低缓，不一定像山口或环形盆壁；默认地形垂直放大 8 倍。

why.key: Toggle Basin overlay on. Trace the rim before any station names. Hide labels with L and ask the class to point: source, tributary, confluence, mouth. Toggle the overlay off and make them find the divide on the hill alone. Orbit the bowl; it is a 3D catchment, not a 2D paint fill. Step the camera from source hill to mouth so each station fills the frame. The green rim is the overlay, not a painted county. Keyboard: L labels, R reset. No year slider — this is a static machine. Finish in Check.
why.zh: 开启流域边界，沿分水岭描一遍；隐藏标签后辨认四个位置，再关闭边界，仅凭地形寻找分水岭。旋转检查坡面与河网关系，L 标签，R 重置。本课没有独立年份时钟。

why.key: Without the 3D view: a rim, a source, tributaries joining at a confluence, a mouth. Rain inside the rim is this river; rain outside is another. The basin is the hillside that drains here, not just the channel. Thames and Mississippi are the same stations at different kilometres. A watershed is a divide, not a garden shed. Vertical exaggeration is a teaching lie; the real divide can be a hedge. Overlay on or off, the divide is still the budget edge. Dams on the Colorado sit inside the rim. Mouth is the exit — estuary or delta as the coast allows.
why.zh: 没有三维时，可画一条分水岭和汇合河网，说明界内外降水的不同去向。河口是出口，不一定有三角洲；潮汐、波浪和输沙共同影响河口形态。英式 watershed 指分水岭，美式用法也常指整个流域，请辨明语境。

steps.key: Toggle the basin overlay. The rim is the watershed — the drainage divide. Trace it before any names.
steps.zh: 打开流域边界，先沿分水岭追踪一圈。

steps.key: Name the stations: source, tributary, confluence, mouth. Hide labels and point again.
steps.zh: 辨认河源、支流、汇流点和河口，再隐藏标签重新指出。

steps.key: Rain on one side of the rim is this river; the other side is someone else’s. The basin is the hillside, not just the channel.
steps.zh: 分水岭两侧的降水流向不同水系；流域包含坡地，不只是河道。

steps.key: 4 questions with explanations. Give a reason for each choice; there is no score gate.
steps.zh: 4 道题，附解析。请说明选择理由。

script.key:
Toggle Basin overlay on. Trace the rim. That rim is the watershed, the drainage divide.
It is not a garden shed. Say the word as a divide.
Hide the labels. Name source, tributary, confluence, mouth.
The basin is not just the channel. It is the whole hillside that drains here.
Rain on one side is this river. The other side is someone else’s.
A confluence is where tributaries meet. The mouth is the exit, not always a delta.
Thames and Mississippi are the same diagram at different size. Colorado is the same rim, drier numbers.
Hide the overlay once and ask the class to point at the divide. Then put it back.
Orbit so the bowl reads as a catchment, not a paint fill. Exaggeration is ×8; say so.
Finish in Check.
script.zh:
打开流域边界，先沿分水岭追踪一圈。
辨认河源、支流、汇流点和河口，再隐藏标签重新指出。
分水岭两侧的降水流向不同水系；流域包含坡地，不只是河道。
最后完成自测，请学生说明判断依据。

pitfalls.key: Confusing watershed with water-shed as in shed building.
pitfalls.zh: 把 watershed 字面理解成储水棚。

pitfalls.key: Teaching the basin as only the blue channel on the map.
pitfalls.zh: 把流域等同于地图上的蓝色河线。

pitfalls.key: Calling every mouth a delta.
pitfalls.zh: 把每个河口都叫作三角洲。

misconceptions.key: The basin is just the channel.
misconceptions.zh: 流域只是河道。

misconceptions.key: It is the whole hillside that drains here.
misconceptions.zh: 它包括所有向该河流排水的坡面与土地。

misconceptions.key: A watershed is a building that stores water.
misconceptions.zh: Watershed 是一栋储水建筑。

misconceptions.key: Watershed means drainage divide — the rim. Say the word as a divide.
misconceptions.zh: 这里按英式地理用法指排水分界；美式用法常指流域。

misconceptions.key: The mouth is always a delta.
misconceptions.zh: 每个河口都是三角洲。

misconceptions.key: The mouth is the exit. Tides and waves can steal the load; many UK rivers end in estuaries.
misconceptions.zh: 河口是出口，是否形成三角洲还取决于输沙与波浪、潮汐等过程。

objective.key: Read rising limb, peak, lag and falling limb, and toggle urban versus rural to change the shape.
objective.zh: 读取涨水段、洪峰、滞后时间和退水段，并比较城市与乡村条件下的曲线。

why.key: A storm hydrograph plots discharge through time. The rising limb, peak, lag and recession describe a catchment response; discharge in m³/s is different from stage in metres. Gold bars show rainfall, and the blue curve shows outflow from this invented catchment.
why.zh: 暴雨流量过程线显示流量随时间变化。涨水段、洪峰、滞后和退水描述流域响应；m³/s 的流量不同于以米计的水位。金色柱为降雨，蓝线为此假定流域的出流。

why.key: The catchment area is 1 km². A four-hour triangular storm peaks at 20 mm/h times Rain. A chosen runoff fraction separates losses from effective rainfall, which passes through a travel delay and a linear storage reservoir. The storage equation conserves water. Urban cover raises the runoff fraction from 0.25 to 0.85 and shortens delay and storage time; these are disclosed teaching assumptions, not calibrated site parameters.
why.zh: 面积为 1 km²，四小时三角形降雨峰值为 20 mm/h 乘以降雨系数。径流系数划分损失与有效降雨，后者经过汇流延迟和线性储库，水量守恒。城市覆盖使径流系数从 0.25 升至 0.85，并缩短延迟与储水时间；这些都是教学假设，未经地点校准。

why.key: Play or scrub Storm hour to follow rainfall and discharge together. Raise Urban cover and compare peak and lag; then increase Rain while holding cover fixed. Lag is measured from the rainfall peak to the discharge peak. The plotted 24-hour window omits part of the long recession; the calculation retains that water in storage.
why.zh: 播放或拖动暴雨小时，将降雨和流量联动比较。先增加城市覆盖观察峰值与滞后，再保持覆盖不变增加降雨。滞后从雨峰量到流量峰。24 小时窗口外尚有退水，其水量仍保留在模型储库中。

why.key: Real response also depends on soil wetness, geology, drains, flood storage and storm pattern. This model does not predict flooding at a named place. Without the canvas, use the labelled hydrograph, its values and the same parameter controls, then explain one reason why two catchments could respond differently.
why.zh: 真实响应还受前期土壤湿度、地质、排水系统、蓄洪空间和雨型影响。此模型不能预测某地点洪水；可用同一参数下图表讨论两个流域响应为何不同。

steps.key: Play the storm. Rain falls, then the river replies: rising limb, peak, lag, falling limb.
steps.zh: 播放降雨过程，辨认河流流量的涨水段、洪峰、滞后及退水段。

steps.key: Raise Urban cover. The hydrograph gets flashier: shorter lag, higher peak. Drop it toward rural: fatter, later.
steps.zh: 增加城市覆盖，比较较短滞后和较高洪峰；降低覆盖，观察响应变缓、峰值推迟。

steps.key: Lag is rain peak to discharge peak. The hill has to drain. Stage is height; discharge is volume per time.
steps.zh: 明确滞后采用降雨峰值到流量峰值的时间差。水位是高度，流量是单位时间通过的体积。

steps.key: 4 questions with explanations. Give a reason for each choice; there is no score gate.
steps.zh: 4 道题，附解析。请说明选择理由。

script.key:
Watch the storm input. Then the river’s reply: rising limb, peak, lag, falling limb.
Lag time is rain peak to discharge peak. The hill has to drain.
The river does not peak when the rain peaks. That is the misconception.
Raise Urban cover. The hydrograph gets flashier: shorter lag, higher peak.
Impermeable surfaces. Water cannot wait in the soil.
Drop Urban cover toward rural. Fatter, later.
Do not mix stage and discharge. Stage is height. Discharge is volume per time.
Somerset Levels can sit on a falling limb for weeks. A flashy urban drain does not.
Name rising, peak, lag, falling out loud before you leave the graph.
Finish in Check.
script.zh:
播放降雨过程，辨认河流流量的涨水段、洪峰、滞后及退水段。
增加城市覆盖，比较较短滞后和较高洪峰；降低覆盖，观察响应变缓、峰值推迟。
明确滞后采用降雨峰值到流量峰值的时间差。水位是高度，流量是单位时间通过的体积。
最后完成自测，请学生说明判断依据。

pitfalls.key: Mixing stage and discharge.
pitfalls.zh: 混淆水位与流量。

pitfalls.key: Teaching the river as peaking with the rain.
pitfalls.zh: 把雨峰和洪峰画在同一时刻。

pitfalls.key: Calling every flood a flash flood — Somerset’s falling limb can last weeks.
pitfalls.zh: 把每种洪水都叫山洪，忽略长退水过程。

misconceptions.key: The river peaks when the rain peaks.
misconceptions.zh: 河流流量峰值必与雨峰同时出现。

misconceptions.key: Lag. The hill has to drain.
misconceptions.zh: 坡面和河网汇流需要时间，通常存在滞后。

misconceptions.key: Stage and discharge are the same thing.
misconceptions.zh: 水位和流量是一回事。

misconceptions.key: Stage is height. Discharge is volume per time. A narrow drain and a wide floodplain disagree.
misconceptions.zh: 水位是水面高度，流量是单位时间通过的水体积，关系依赖断面。

misconceptions.key: Urban land use stops flooding by putting water in pipes.
misconceptions.zh: 城市管道把水收走，就不会洪水。

misconceptions.key: Pipes and roofs shorten lag and raise the peak. The water still has to go somewhere.
misconceptions.zh: 屋顶与排水系统可能缩短滞后、抬高洪峰，水仍需输送和储存。

objective.key: Compare two annual regimes and say what rain, snowmelt and dams do to the year’s personality.
objective.zh: 比较两种年内流量变化，解释降雨、融雪与水坝调节的作用。

why.key: A river regime describes discharge through the year. Seasonal rain, snowfall and melt, evapotranspiration, catchment storage and management all affect it. An annual regime differs from the short response to one storm; use Hydrograph for that event-scale question.
why.zh: 河流水文情势描述一年内流量变化，受季节降水、积雪融化、蒸散、流域储水和调控影响。它不同于一次暴雨之后的短期流量过程线。

why.key: These two invented 100 km² catchments use repeating 365-day forcing. The rain-fed case has wetter winters, no snow and ten-day linear routing. The snow-fed case stores precipitation below 0 °C and melts up to 3 mm water equivalent per positive degree Celsius per day. Its routing time is seven days. Fixed fractions of liquid input, 40% and 25%, are assigned to losses; no detailed evapotranspiration or groundwater model is solved.
why.zh: 两个假定流域面积均为 100 km²，使用重复的 365 天气象输入。雨养流域冬季较湿、无雪，线性汇流时间 10 天；雪养流域在 0 °C 以下储雪，每日每正积温度融化最多 3 mm 水当量，汇流时间 7 天。液态输入固定损失分别为 40% 和 25%，未求解详细蒸散或地下水。

why.key: Play or scrub Year to link the terrain, snow store and discharge graph. Gold is rain-fed and blue snow-fed; snow depth is reported as water equivalent, not physical snowpack thickness. Dam adds a sixty-day linear reservoir to the snow-fed river, smoothing and delaying flow while conserving the annual budget after spin-up. This is storage behaviour, not an actual dam rule curve or capacity calculation.
why.zh: 年份滑块联动地形、雪储量和流量图。金线是雨养，蓝线是雪养；雪深用水当量表示，不是实际雪层厚度。水坝为雪养河流加入 60 天线性储库，平滑并延迟流量，预热后年收支守恒；它不是实际运行规则或库容设计。

why.key: All precipitation is accounted for between losses, snow, routing, reservoir and river outflow. The 3D terrain is illustrative, with relief enlarged tenfold until T is pressed; channel width and the dam are symbols. These regimes are not records of the Thames, Colorado or another named river, and they are not forecasts. Actual regimes vary between years and sites.
why.zh: 所有降水均计入损失、雪、汇流储库、水库和出流。地形示意，默认地形起伏放大 10 倍，T 恢复；河宽和坝体仍是符号。这些曲线不是泰晤士河、科罗拉多河等真实记录，也不是预报。

steps.key: Read the gold and blue annual discharge curves. Scrub through winter and locate water stored as snow.
steps.zh: 读取金色与蓝色年流量曲线，拖过冬季，找到储存在积雪中的水。

steps.key: Follow the melt season and compare its flow peak with winter rain. Switch the dam on and compare the peak and delayed release.
steps.zh: 追踪融雪季，将流量峰值与冬雨型比较。开启大坝，观察削峰和延迟释放。

steps.key: Distinguish a conserved model budget from measured river records.
steps.zh: 区分守恒的模型水量预算与实测河流记录。

steps.key: 4 questions with explanations. Give a reason for each choice; there is no score gate.
steps.zh: 4 道题，附解析。请说明选择理由。

script.key:
Read the gold and blue annual discharge curves.
Scrub through winter and locate water stored as snow.
Follow the melt season and compare its flow peak with winter rain.
Switch the dam on and compare the peak and delayed release.
Distinguish a conserved model budget from measured river records.
Finish in Check.
script.zh:
读取金色与蓝色年流量曲线，拖过冬季，找到储存在积雪中的水。
追踪融雪季，将流量峰值与冬雨型比较。开启大坝，观察削峰和延迟释放。
区分守恒的模型水量预算与实测河流记录。
最后完成自测，请学生说明判断依据。

pitfalls.key: One graph for all climates.
pitfalls.zh: 用一条曲线代表所有气候。

pitfalls.key: Pasting a storm hydrograph onto a monthly axis.
pitfalls.zh: 把暴雨涨水段直接放到月份轴上。

pitfalls.key: Inventing peak-flow numbers the traces do not give.
pitfalls.zh: 编造曲线未给出的峰值流量。

misconceptions.key: All rivers peak in summer.
misconceptions.zh: 所有河流都在夏天达到峰值。

misconceptions.key: Depends on rain, snow, dams, ice.
misconceptions.zh: 取决于降雨、融雪、冰和水坝等条件。

misconceptions.key: A storm hydrograph and a regime graph are the same plot.
misconceptions.zh: 暴雨过程线和年内水文情势是同一张图。

misconceptions.key: Hours versus the year. Do not paste a rising limb onto a monthly axis.
misconceptions.zh: 前者常以小时计，后者描述一年中的变化。

misconceptions.key: One graph will do for all climates.
misconceptions.zh: 一种曲线可代表全部气候。

misconceptions.key: UK upland mix, Mississippi continental year, Colorado snowpack: different machines, same idea.
misconceptions.zh: 不同气候、积雪和调控条件会形成不同年内过程。

objective.key: See surface gyres and a Gulf Stream ribbon, and keep UK winter language honest: one term in a budget, not a magic radiator.
objective.zh: 观察表层大洋环流与湾流，理解洋流只是英国冬季能量收支的一部分。

why.key: Subtropical gyres are large systems of wind-driven surface currents. Trade winds, westerlies, rotation and basin boundaries contribute to their circulation. Northern subtropical gyres turn clockwise on a map; southern ones turn anticlockwise. This rule does not describe every ocean current or subpolar gyre.
why.zh: 副热带环流是大型风驱表层洋流系统，由信风、西风、自转和海盆边界共同影响。北半球副热带环流从地图上看顺时针，南半球逆时针；不能将此规则套用到所有洋流或副极地环流。

why.key: Choose one of five basins. Amber marks the warm, poleward western-boundary branch; blue marks the cooler equatorward eastern branch. Grey connects them schematically. Western boundary currents such as the Gulf Stream and Kuroshio are relatively narrow and fast. The width of a line here is a symbol, not a measured current width.
why.zh: 选择五个海盆之一。琥珀色为温暖向极的西边界支流，蓝色为较冷向赤道的东边界支流，灰线作示意连接。湾流、黑潮等西边界流相对窄而快，图上线宽不代表实测宽度。

why.key: The NASA globe supplies geographic context. Routes are hand-selected teaching paths, not satellite-derived streamlines. Play moves tracers in the direction of flow; their speed and spacing do not report velocity, transport or travel time. Rotate and zoom to identify the two sides of each basin.
why.zh: NASA 地球图提供地理背景，路径为人工选取的教学路线，不是卫星测得流线。播放显示流向，示踪点速度和间距不表示实际流速、输运量或旅行时间。旋转辨认每个海盆的东西边界。

why.key: The Gulf Stream does not run as one uninterrupted ribbon to a British beach. Its downstream extensions, other ocean circulation and atmospheric heat transport all matter. UK winter climate reflects westerlies, ocean heat and geography together. Use the separate Thermohaline lab to distinguish surface gyres from overturning; neither view is a navigation or weather forecast.
why.zh: 湾流并非一条不断开的暖水带直接通向英国海滩。其延伸、其他洋流与大气热输送共同影响气候。英国冬季受西风、海洋热量与地理位置等共同作用；深层翻转环流另见温盐环流实验。

steps.key: Select North Atlantic and identify its western and eastern boundaries. Follow the arrows and name Gulf Stream and Canary Current.
steps.zh: 选择北大西洋，辨认西部和东部边界，沿箭头找到湾流与加那利寒流。

steps.key: Compare South Atlantic and explain the reversed sense of rotation. Locate all five subtropical gyres.
steps.zh: 比较南大西洋反向旋转的环流，再定位五个副热带环流。

steps.key: Distinguish a teaching route from measured current data and qualify the UK winter claim.
steps.zh: 区分教学路径与实测洋流数据，并说明英国冬季气候还有其他影响因素。

steps.key: 4 questions with explanations. Give a reason for each choice; there is no score gate.
steps.zh: 4 道题，附解析。请说明选择理由。

script.key:
Select North Atlantic and identify its western and eastern boundaries.
Follow the arrows and name Gulf Stream and Canary Current.
Compare South Atlantic and explain the reversed sense of rotation.
Locate all five subtropical gyres.
Distinguish a teaching route from measured current data and qualify the UK winter claim.
Finish in Check.
script.zh:
选择北大西洋，辨认西部和东部边界，沿箭头找到湾流与加那利寒流。
比较南大西洋反向旋转的环流，再定位五个副热带环流。
区分教学路径与实测洋流数据，并说明英国冬季气候还有其他影响因素。
最后完成自测，请学生说明判断依据。

pitfalls.key: Gulf Stream as a magic radiator.
pitfalls.zh: 把湾流当成万能暖气。

pitfalls.key: Treating surface gyres as the deep conveyor.
pitfalls.zh: 把表层环流当作深海传送带。

pitfalls.key: Overclaiming UK winter as 100% Gulf Stream.
pitfalls.zh: 把英国温和冬季完全归于湾流。

misconceptions.key: The Gulf Stream is why Britain has weather at all.
misconceptions.zh: 英国之所以有天气，完全因为湾流。

misconceptions.key: It is one term in a budget.
misconceptions.zh: 湾流只是能量与环流系统中的一个因素。

misconceptions.key: The Gulf Stream is a magic radiator for every British garden.
misconceptions.zh: 湾流像暖气一样控制每座英国花园。

misconceptions.key: Latitude, westerlies and ocean heat share the work. The ribbon helps; it does not run the seasons.
misconceptions.zh: 纬度、西风和海洋热量共同起作用，湾流不会单独决定季节。

misconceptions.key: All ocean currents are the deep conveyor.
misconceptions.zh: 所有洋流都是深海传送带。

misconceptions.key: These are surface gyres. The density-driven loop is a different lab.
misconceptions.zh: 这里是表层风驱环流，与深层翻转过程需要区分。

objective.key: Follow a schematic overturning section, then test how cooling and freshening compete in a separate density experiment.
objective.zh: 追踪简化翻转环流剖面，再通过独立密度实验比较冷却与淡化的相反作用。

why.key: Temperature and salinity influence seawater density. Surface cooling and evaporation or sea-ice formation can increase density, while warming and freshwater input can lower it. Dense-water formation contributes to overturning. The full circulation also needs winds and turbulent mixing; it is not powered by sinking alone.
why.zh: 表层冷却、蒸发或海冰形成可使海水密度增加，增温和淡水输入可使其降低。高密度水形成有助于翻转环流，但完整循环还需风和湍流混合，不能只靠下沉驱动。

why.key: Overturning section shows a warm upper limb, high-latitude deep-water formation, a colder deep return and upwelling. It is a regional schematic, not a continuous global pipe or a prediction of AMOC transport. The 6000 km section is 4 km deep; the usual view enlarges depth 500 times. T restores equal scales. Tracer animation has no assigned transit time.
why.zh: 剖面展示暖上层支流、高纬深水形成、冷深层回流和上升流，是区域示意，不是全球连续管道或 AMOC 输运预报。剖面宽 6000 km、深 4 km，默认深度放大 500 倍；T 恢复比例，粒子播放没有指定真实通过时间。

why.key: Choose Density experiment to adjust the parcel temperature and Absolute Salinity. Reference water is 10 °C, 35 g/kg and 1027 kg/m³. A disclosed linear approximation uses thermal expansion 0.0002 per °C and saline contraction 0.00076 per g/kg at a common reference pressure. This is not the TEOS-10 equation of state; real coefficients and compressibility vary. Practical Salinity is a different, unitless quantity.
why.zh: 密度实验可调温度与绝对盐度。参考水为 10 °C、35 g/kg、1027 kg/m³；同一参考压强下采用线性热膨胀系数 0.0002/°C、盐收缩系数 0.00076/(g/kg)。这不是 TEOS-10 状态方程，真实系数与可压缩性会变化；实用盐度是另一种无量纲量。

why.key: Play releases a parcel at mid-depth: denser water sinks, lighter water rises and equal-density water remains level. Travel speed, mixing and entrainment are not solved. Compare 4 °C at 35 g/kg with the same temperature at 32 g/kg. Freshening can offset cooling in this experiment. These controls do not calculate ocean transport, a tipping threshold or a shutdown date.
why.zh: 播放从中层释放水团：较密下沉、较轻上升、等密保持高度。没有求解速度、混合和卷吸。比较 4 °C、35 g/kg 与 4 °C、32 g/kg，观察淡化如何抵消冷却增密；这些参数不能给出输运量、临界点或停转日期。

steps.key: Trace the upper limb, deep return and upwelling in the section. Name winds and mixing as well as buoyancy.
steps.zh: 沿剖面追踪上层流、深层返回流和上升流，同时考虑浮力、风与混合。

steps.key: Open Density experiment and compare parcel density with the reference. Start at Process 0: the parcel is at mid-depth. At 4 °C and 35 g/kg, play to observe descent.
steps.zh: 打开密度实验，比较水团与参考海水密度。进程归零，将水温设为 4 °C、盐度设为 35 g/kg，播放观察下沉。

steps.key: Lower salinity to 32 g/kg, return to Process 0 and replay to observe ascent. Read the approximation and explain why it is not an AMOC forecast.
steps.zh: 降到 32 g/kg，进程归零后重播，观察上升。说明近似条件，以及这为何不是 AMOC 预报。

steps.key: 4 questions with explanations. Give a reason for each choice; there is no score gate.
steps.zh: 4 道题，附解析。请说明选择理由。

script.key:
Trace the upper limb, deep return and upwelling in the section.
Name winds and mixing as well as buoyancy.
Open Density experiment and compare parcel density with the reference.
Start at Process 0: the parcel is at mid-depth. At 4 °C and 35 g/kg, play to observe descent.
Lower salinity to 32 g/kg, return to Process 0 and replay to observe ascent.
Read the approximation and explain why it is not an AMOC forecast.
Finish in Check.
script.zh:
沿剖面追踪上层流、深层返回流和上升流，同时考虑浮力、风与混合。
打开密度实验，比较水团与参考海水密度。进程归零，将水温设为 4 °C、盐度设为 35 g/kg，播放观察下沉。
降到 32 g/kg，进程归零后重播，观察上升。说明近似条件，以及这为何不是 AMOC 预报。
最后完成自测，请学生说明判断依据。

pitfalls.key: Day-after-tomorrow cinema as fact.
pitfalls.zh: 把灾难电影当成环流预测。

pitfalls.key: Teaching the conveyor as a pipe under the Atlantic.
pitfalls.zh: 把示意传送带当成海底管道。

pitfalls.key: Putting deep-water formation on the equator because the Sun is ‘stronger’ there.
pitfalls.zh: 因为赤道太阳强，就把深水形成放在赤道。

misconceptions.key: It will switch off next Tuesday.
misconceptions.zh: 它将在下周二突然停止。

misconceptions.key: It can change; headlines are not a lab.
misconceptions.zh: 环流可能变化，但这个实验不能给出倒计时或停转预测。

misconceptions.key: The conveyor is a pipe you could visit in a submarine.
misconceptions.zh: 传送带是潜艇能找到的一根管道。

misconceptions.key: It is a school cartoon of a slow, messy, global density circulation. Flag the simplification.
misconceptions.zh: 它是复杂、分布式翻转环流的教学简化。

misconceptions.key: Deep water forms in the warm equatorial shallows because the Sun is strongest there.
misconceptions.zh: 深水主要在太阳最强的赤道浅海形成。

misconceptions.key: Sinking wants density. Cold, often salty high-latitude seas, not the equator.
misconceptions.zh: 深水形成需要足够密的水，常发生在寒冷且较咸的高纬海域。

objective.key: Name stores, watch arrows, and open a fossil-fuel tap as a transfer from a slow geologic store into the fast cycle.
objective.zh: 辨认碳储库，追踪输送，并观察化石燃料如何把地质慢循环中的碳释放到快速循环。

why.key: Carbon moves between atmosphere, living things and soils, ocean, sediment and rock, and fossil fuels. Photosynthesis and respiration exchange carbon between air and biosphere. Air and ocean exchange it in both directions. Geological pathways operate over much longer times. Combustion transfers existing carbon atoms from fossil fuel to the atmosphere.
why.zh: 碳在大气、生物与土壤、海洋、沉积岩石和化石燃料之间转移。光合与呼吸连接空气和生物圈，海气交换双向进行，地质途径时间更长。燃烧把已有碳原子从燃料转入大气。

why.key: This experiment is an explicitly invented closed budget, not a reconstruction of the measured Earth. Starting stores are 600, 1200, 3000, 6000 and 1200 Pg C respectively. One petagram of carbon is 10¹² kg of carbon, not of CO₂. Sphere volume is proportional to each store; their positions and separations have no geographic meaning.
why.zh: 这是明确虚构的封闭收支，不是实测地球重建。五个初始储量依次为 600、1200、3000、6000、1200 Pg C；1 Pg C 为 10¹² kg 碳，不是 CO₂ 质量。球体体积与储量成正比，位置没有地理意义。

why.key: Select a transfer to see its source, destination and rate. At the starting state, photosynthesis and respiration each transfer 60 Pg C/year, air–ocean exchange 40 in each direction, and the weathering–burial–degassing loop 0.2 on each leg. Each natural outgoing flux subsequently scales with its source store. The fossil-fuel tap adds 0–10 Pg C/year to air for up to 100 model years. Every flux is subtracted from one store and added to another.
why.zh: 选一条转移查看起点、终点和速率。初始光合、呼吸各 60 Pg C/年，海气交换各 40，风化—埋藏—逸气循环各 0.2。此后自然通量按源库储量缩放。燃料开关在最多 100 模型年内加入 0–10 Pg C/年，每项通量都从源库减去并加入目标库。

why.key: Scrub Process or Play. With the tap closed, the chosen natural flows balance. With it open, fossil carbon falls and the fast stores change while total carbon remains 12000 Pg C. Changing the tap recalculates the experiment from its initial state. No feedbacks, measured present-day rates, atmospheric ppm or climate response are inferred. The weathering pathway summarises uptake and transport to the ocean; it is not a claim that all rock weathering consumes CO₂.
why.zh: 关闭燃料开关时初始自然通量平衡；开启后化石碳减少、快库改变，总量仍为 12000 Pg C。改开关会从初始状态重算。模型不包含反馈、不推算 ppm 或气候响应，也不代表当代实测通量。风化路径概括吸收和向海输送，不意味着所有风化都消耗 CO₂。

steps.key: Name the five stores and read the invented-budget label. Close the fossil-fuel tap and play; distinguish balanced exchange from no exchange.
steps.zh: 辨认五个碳储库及假设预算。关闭化石燃料输入并播放，区分平衡交换与没有交换。

steps.key: Choose Photosynthesis and Respiration separately. Open the tap, scrub towards 100 model years, and compare source loss with total emitted carbon.
steps.zh: 分别选择光合作用、呼吸，再打开输入，拖到接近 100 个模型年，比较源库减少与累计排放。

steps.key: Check the fixed total and explain why atmospheric gain differs from total emissions.
steps.zh: 核对总量不变，并解释大气增加量为何不等于累计排放量。

steps.key: 4 questions with explanations. Give a reason for each choice; there is no score gate.
steps.zh: 4 道题，附解析。请说明选择理由。

script.key:
Name the five stores and read the invented-budget label.
Close the fossil-fuel tap and play; distinguish balanced exchange from no exchange.
Choose Photosynthesis and Respiration separately.
Open the tap, scrub towards 100 model years, and compare source loss with total emitted carbon.
Check the fixed total and explain why atmospheric gain differs from total emissions.
Finish in Check.
script.zh:
辨认五个碳储库及假设预算。关闭化石燃料输入并播放，区分平衡交换与没有交换。
分别选择光合作用、呼吸，再打开输入，拖到接近 100 个模型年，比较源库减少与累计排放。
核对总量不变，并解释大气增加量为何不等于累计排放量。
最后完成自测，请学生说明判断依据。

pitfalls.key: One arrow salad with no named stores.
pitfalls.zh: 只画箭头，不命名储库。

pitfalls.key: Teaching burning as creating new carbon atoms.
pitfalls.zh: 说燃烧创造碳原子。

pitfalls.key: Inventing petagram numbers the boxes do not give.
pitfalls.zh: 编造图中未给出的 Pg 数值。

misconceptions.key: Burning fuel creates new carbon atoms.
misconceptions.zh: 燃烧创造新碳原子。

misconceptions.key: It moves them from a slow store to the air.
misconceptions.zh: 燃烧将碳从慢库转移到空气中。

misconceptions.key: The ocean store does not talk to the air.
misconceptions.zh: 海洋碳库不与空气交流。

misconceptions.key: It exchanges carbon with the atmosphere both ways.
misconceptions.zh: 海洋和大气双向交换碳。

misconceptions.key: Weathering is a fast daily flux like respiration.
misconceptions.zh: 地质风化与呼吸一样是快速日通量。

misconceptions.key: Weathering is slow. Fast and slow are different arrows on the same diagram.
misconceptions.zh: 慢地质循环与快生物循环的时间尺度不同。

objective.key: See the Walker cell, El Niño and La Niña as Pacific ocean–atmosphere states, and refuse overclaim for a UK winter.
objective.zh: 理解沃克环流、厄尔尼诺与拉尼娜所对应的太平洋海气状态，不把它们直接当作英国冬季预报。

why.key: ENSO couples the tropical Pacific ocean and atmosphere. In neutral conditions, easterly trades favour warm water in the west and a thermocline that is shallower in the east. Convection is stronger over the warm western Pacific, with an eastward return aloft and westward surface flow in the Walker circulation.
why.zh: ENSO 是热带太平洋海气耦合现象。中性状态下，偏东信风有利于西侧暖水堆积、东侧温跃层较浅；西部暖海上对流较强，高空向东返回、地面向西，构成沃克环流。

why.key: Move ENSO towards El Niño. The prescribed thermocline becomes flatter, eastern surface water warms, trades and eastern upwelling weaken, and principal ascent shifts towards the central Pacific. La Niña strengthens the contrasting pattern. Real events vary; their centres, timing and strength cannot be inferred from this single slider.
why.zh: 滑向厄尔尼诺时，指定温跃层变平，东侧表水增温，信风与东部上升流减弱，主要上升区向中太平洋移动。拉尼娜增强相反格局。真实事件位置、时间与强度不同，不能从单个滑块推断。

why.key: The ocean cross-section is 15000 km wide and shows its upper 500 m. Depth is enlarged 10000 times until T is pressed. Gold marks an ideal thermocline, amber the warmer upper water and blue colder water. Read the western and eastern depths and temperatures. These values are teaching inputs, not observations or an ENSO-index calibration. Atmospheric loop height is separately schematic.
why.zh: 海洋剖面宽 15000 km，显示上部 500 m，默认深度放大 10000 倍，T 恢复。金线为理想温跃层，琥珀色为较暖上层，蓝色为较冷下层。读数均为教学输入，不是观测或 ENSO 指数校准；大气环流高度另作示意。

why.key: Play animates illustrative circulation tracers within the selected state. It does not simulate an event evolving through time or make a forecast. ENSO can alter remote weather probabilities through teleconnections; it does not prescribe a particular UK winter, flood or snowfall. Use current observational analysis for claims about an actual event.
why.zh: 播放只是让粒子在选定状态中移动，并不模拟 ENSO 事件随时间演化。遥相关可能改变远方天气概率，但不能指定英国某次冬季降雪或洪水。实际事件需查当前观测分析。

steps.key: Start at ENSO 0 and identify west, east and the thermocline. Trace rising air in the west and surface trades towards it.
steps.zh: 从 ENSO 0 开始辨认东西方向和温跃层，追踪西部上升气流及朝西吹的近地面信风。

steps.key: Move to El Niño and compare eastern temperature and thermocline depth. Compare La Niña and explain the stronger contrast.
steps.zh: 切到厄尔尼诺，比较东部温度与温跃层深度；再比较拉尼娜更强的东西差异。

steps.key: Press T; separate ocean depth scale from the schematic atmosphere. State one limit on remote winter predictions before Check.
steps.zh: 按 T 区分海洋深度比例与示意大气，指出远距离冬季预测的一项限制，再自测。

steps.key: 4 questions with explanations. Give a reason for each choice; there is no score gate.
steps.zh: 4 道题，附解析。请说明选择理由。

script.key:
Start at ENSO 0 and identify west, east and the thermocline.
Trace rising air in the west and surface trades towards it.
Move to El Niño and compare eastern temperature and thermocline depth.
Compare La Niña and explain the stronger contrast.
Press T; separate ocean depth scale from the schematic atmosphere.
State one limit on remote winter predictions before Check.
script.zh:
从 ENSO 0 开始辨认东西方向和温跃层，追踪西部上升气流及朝西吹的近地面信风。
切到厄尔尼诺，比较东部温度与温跃层深度；再比较拉尼娜更强的东西差异。
按 T 区分海洋深度比例与示意大气，指出远距离冬季预测的一项限制，再自测。
最后完成自测，请学生说明判断依据。

pitfalls.key: Tabloid ENSO.
pitfalls.zh: 用戏剧化新闻代替机制。

pitfalls.key: Promising a UK White Christmas from the slider.
pitfalls.zh: 从滑块承诺英国圣诞降雪。

pitfalls.key: Putting the warm pool over the British Isles.
pitfalls.zh: 把太平洋暖池放到英国附近。

misconceptions.key: El Niño is a storm that hits London.
misconceptions.zh: 厄尔尼诺是一场袭击伦敦的风暴。

misconceptions.key: It is a Pacific ocean–atmosphere state with teleconnections.
misconceptions.zh: 它是太平洋海气状态，可通过遥相关影响远方概率。

misconceptions.key: ENSO always means a White Christmas in the UK.
misconceptions.zh: ENSO 一定带来英国白色圣诞节。

misconceptions.key: Teleconnections may bias odds. They do not write the month, and they do not promise snow.
misconceptions.zh: 它可能影响概率，但不保证某日降雪。

misconceptions.key: El Niño is a personality of the weather.
misconceptions.zh: 厄尔尼诺是天气的情绪。

misconceptions.key: It is a named phase of a Pacific state. Neutral, El Niño, La Niña — not moods.
misconceptions.zh: 它是可观测海气状态的一种位相，另有中性和拉尼娜。

objective.key: Compare mountain, hill, plateau, plain, and basin at one scale.
objective.zh: 在统一比例下比较山地、丘陵、高原、平原与盆地。

why.key: Landforms can be described by elevation, relief, slope and shape. These properties are related but different. A high surface can be relatively flat; a low-lying place can have a steep local slope. Shape alone does not identify the rock or process that formed it.
why.zh: 地貌可用海拔、相对起伏、坡度与形状描述。高海拔地面可以平坦，低地也可有陡坡；单凭形状不能确定岩性或成因。

why.key: Choose any two of five invented terrain samples. Each covers 4 by 4 km at the same scale. The mountain is rugged and high-relief, the hill lower and gentler, the plateau elevated with a relatively level top, the plain low-relief and the basin a depression relative to its surroundings.
why.zh: 从五种假定地形中选两种比较，每块均为 4 × 4 km、比例一致。山地起伏大而崎岖，丘陵较低缓，高原较高且顶部较平，平原起伏小，盆地相对周围低。

why.key: The default view enlarges relief twice in both samples. T restores equal horizontal and vertical scales. Rotate and zoom without changing their relative dimensions. There is no universal height threshold dividing every hill from a mountain. Plains need not lie near sea level, and a basin need not hold a lake.
why.zh: 默认两块地形都将垂直起伏放大 2 倍，T 恢复共同尺度。旋转缩放保持彼此相对尺寸。山和丘陵没有全球统一高度门槛，平原不必接近海平面，盆地也不一定有湖。

why.key: These shapes are comparison surfaces, not elevation surveys of named places. Vegetation-like colour and rock texture aid reading and do not establish climate, lithology or origin. Use real photographs and topographic data to test whether a local example matches a description, then compare the processes in other landform labs.
why.zh: 这些是比较用地表，不是特定地点测绘。植被色和岩石材质帮助辨认，但不能据此确定气候、岩性或形成过程。应结合真实照片和高程资料判断当地实例。

steps.key: Compare Mountain with Plain at the common scale. Distinguish elevation from local relief.
steps.zh: 按相同比例比较山地与平原，区分海拔和局部起伏。

steps.key: Replace Plain with Plateau and explain its high flat surface. Compare Hill and Basin, then rotate both.
steps.zh: 将平原换成高原，解释高而平的表面；再旋转比较丘陵与盆地。

steps.key: Press T and qualify the generalisations: plains can be high and basins need not be lakes.
steps.zh: 按 T 查看真实比例，并补充：平原也可位于高海拔，盆地不一定有湖泊。

steps.key: 4 questions with explanations. Give a reason for each choice; there is no score gate.
steps.zh: 4 道题，附解析。请说明选择理由。

script.key:
Compare Mountain with Plain at the common scale.
Distinguish elevation from local relief.
Replace Plain with Plateau and explain its high flat surface.
Compare Hill and Basin, then rotate both.
Press T and qualify the generalisations: plains can be high and basins need not be lakes.
Finish in Check.
script.zh:
按相同比例比较山地与平原，区分海拔和局部起伏。
将平原换成高原，解释高而平的表面；再旋转比较丘陵与盆地。
按 T 查看真实比例，并补充：平原也可位于高海拔，盆地不一定有湖泊。
最后完成自测，请学生说明判断依据。

pitfalls.key: Teaching five words as five laws of nature.
pitfalls.zh: 把五个名称教成五条绝对自然定律。

pitfalls.key: Calling the Grand Canyon a mountain range.
pitfalls.zh: 把大峡谷称为山脉。

pitfalls.key: Treating mountain versus hill as a fixed-height law.
pitfalls.zh: 给山与丘陵制定全球固定高度门槛。

misconceptions.key: Every high place is a mountain.
misconceptions.zh: 所有高处都是山。

misconceptions.key: Plateaus are high and flat. Hills are smaller relief.
misconceptions.zh: 高原海拔高但可较平坦，丘陵和山地需结合起伏与坡度判断。

misconceptions.key: The Grand Canyon is a mountain range.
misconceptions.zh: 大峡谷是一条山脉。

misconceptions.key: It is a canyon cut into a plateau. The plateau is the landform type; the canyon is the hole.
misconceptions.zh: 它是切入高原的峡谷，地表高原与切割谷地需区分。

misconceptions.key: Mountain versus hill is a law with a fixed height.
misconceptions.zh: 山和丘陵有全球固定高度界线。

misconceptions.key: Definitions vary by country. Compare relief, slope and local height. Do not legislate.
misconceptions.zh: 各地定义不同，应比较局部高度、起伏与坡度。

objective.key: Identify a waterfall, gorge, pothole and V-shaped valley; distinguish upstream retreat from downstream flow.
objective.zh: 辨认瀑布、峡谷、壶穴与 V 形谷，并区分瀑布向上游后退和流水向下游运动。

why.key: River erosion includes abrasion by transported sediment, hydraulic action and dissolution where minerals are soluble. Weathering weakens rock in place, while erosion removes and transports it. A river valley reflects both channel incision and changes on its sides.
why.zh: 河流侵蚀包括搬运颗粒的磨蚀、水力作用，以及可溶矿物的溶解。风化在原地削弱岩石，侵蚀使物质移除并搬运。河谷既受河道下切，也受两侧坡面变化影响。

why.key: The waterfall example has resistant cap rock above weaker rock. Undercutting and collapse can move the lip upstream while water flows downstream, leaving a gorge. Change Retreat to move the lip through a prescribed 25 m sequence; the falling water and plunge pool follow the new lip. This is one possible geological arrangement, not an explanation of every waterfall.
why.zh: 例中坚硬盖层位于较弱岩层上方，掏蚀和坍塌使瀑布向上游后退，留下峡谷。后退滑块选择预设的 25 m 变化序列，落水与潭随崖口移动。这是可能的地质配置，不适用于所有瀑布。

why.key: Select Pothole close-up to inspect a closed bedrock hollow. Rotating sediment illustrates abrasion by turbulent flow; the enlarged particles and chosen circulation are not a fluid simulation. Select V-shaped valley to distinguish a narrow river channel from the much wider slopes affected by weathering and mass movement.
why.zh: 壶穴近景展示封闭岩床凹坑，旋转颗粒说明湍流带来的磨蚀；颗粒放大且轨道指定，并非流体模拟。V 形谷模式可区分窄河道与受风化、重力运动影响的宽坡面。

why.key: Play moves water or sediment tracers only. The terrain examples do not solve erosion rates, landform ages or sediment export. The waterfall and valley view enlarges vertical relief 1.5 times; T restores common distances. The pothole is a separate metre-scale close-up. Use the real landscape photograph to identify evidence before deciding which processes acted there.
why.zh: 播放只移动水或颗粒示踪点，不求解侵蚀率、地貌年龄和泥沙输出。瀑布与河谷默认垂直放大 1.5 倍，T 恢复；壶穴为独立米尺度近景。真实景观的成因需先找证据再判断。

steps.key: Follow water downstream, then identify the lip and plunge pool.
steps.zh: 沿水流向下游追踪，找到瀑布唇部和跌水潭。

steps.key: Change Retreat to move the lip upstream; select Pothole or V-shaped valley.
steps.zh: 改变后退量，让瀑布向上游移动；再选壶穴或 V 形谷。

steps.key: Explain erosion, weathering and slope movement separately.
steps.zh: 分别解释流水侵蚀、原地风化及坡面重力运动。

steps.key: 4 questions with explanations. Give a reason for each choice; there is no score gate.
steps.zh: 4 道题，附解析。请说明选择理由。

script.key:
Trace water downstream, then increase Retreat and identify the opposite direction of lip migration.
Locate resistant cap, plunge pool and gorge.
Select Pothole close-up and identify abrasive sediment.
Select V-shaped valley and include slope processes in the explanation.
Press T and state what the geometry does not calculate.
Finish in Check.
script.zh:
沿水流向下游追踪，找到瀑布唇部和跌水潭。
改变后退量，让瀑布向上游移动；再选壶穴或 V 形谷。
分别解释流水侵蚀、原地风化及坡面重力运动。
最后完成自测，请学生说明判断依据。

pitfalls.key: Calling every valley a canyon.
pitfalls.zh: 把所有谷地称为峡谷。

pitfalls.key: Teaching waterfalls as furniture that never moves.
pitfalls.zh: 把瀑布视为不会移动的固定景物。

pitfalls.key: Confusing the age of the rocks with the age of the hole.
pitfalls.zh: 混淆岩石形成与谷地切割年龄。

misconceptions.key: Waterfalls stay put.
misconceptions.zh: 瀑布永远固定在原处。

misconceptions.key: They retreat. Niagara is the famous slow walk. A Lake District fall on a resistant band does the same.
misconceptions.zh: 侵蚀与岩层坍塌可使瀑布逐渐向上游后退。

misconceptions.key: Every valley is a canyon.
misconceptions.zh: 所有谷地都叫峡谷。

misconceptions.key: A canyon is a deep, steep-sided incision. V-valleys are upland fluvial. Ice makes U.
misconceptions.zh: 峡谷强调深切和陡壁，河流 V 形谷与冰川 U 形谷结构不同。

misconceptions.key: The age of the canyon is the age of the rocks in the walls.
misconceptions.zh: 峡谷年龄等于谷壁岩石年龄。

misconceptions.key: Rocks can be hundreds of millions of years old. The hole is much younger. Incision is not the birthday of the beds.
misconceptions.zh: 岩石可古老得多，后来的切割才形成谷地。

objective.key: Distinguish point bars, natural levees and deltas, and relate a simple settling calculation to its assumptions.
objective.zh: 区分点坝、天然堤和三角洲，并理解简化沉降计算的适用假设。

why.key: Deposition occurs when sediment settles or comes to rest. It depends on sediment supply, grain properties and the transport conditions, rather than on river position alone. Erosion and deposition can occur at the same time in different parts of a reach.
why.zh: 沉积是颗粒沉降或停止搬运，取决于供应、颗粒性质和输运条件，而不是仅由河段位置决定。同一河段不同部位可同时侵蚀与沉积。

why.key: The curved channel places a point bar on the inner bank. The floodplain view shows low natural levees beside the channel; repeated overbank flow can deposit relatively coarse material there and carry finer material farther. Toggle Overbank water to reveal the relief. A natural levee is not an engineered embankment.
why.zh: 弯曲河道内侧形成边滩。洪泛平原模式显示邻近河道的低天然堤，反复漫滩时较粗颗粒常先在岸边沉积，细粒可被带得更远。切换漫滩水查看起伏；天然堤不是人工堤防。

why.key: The mouth view shows one delta with distributary channels. A delta can grow where sediment accumulates faster than it is removed and available space is filled. Waves, tides, subsidence, sea-level change and sediment supply all matter. Many river mouths instead form estuaries; the model is not a claim that every river must build a delta.
why.zh: 河口模式展示一处分汊三角洲。泥沙积累超过移除并逐渐填充容纳空间时可生长，波浪、潮汐、沉降、海平面和来沙都重要。许多河流形成河口湾，不能认为每条河都必须建成三角洲。

why.key: A separate Stokes calculation uses isolated 10–50 μm quartz spheres, still fresh water at 20 °C, density 998 kg/m³ and dynamic viscosity 1.002 mPa·s. It estimates terminal settling speed and the distance travelled at 0.1 m/s through 2 m depth. Smaller particles settle more slowly. Turbulence, flocculation and non-spherical grains are excluded. The calculation does not drive the terrain or predict real deposition rates; Play illustrates downstream transport only.
why.zh: 独立斯托克斯计算采用 20 °C 静止淡水中 10–50 μm 单颗粒石英球，水密度 998 kg/m³、动力黏度 1.002 mPa·s，估计终端沉速和以 0.1 m/s 水平移动、下沉 2 m 的距离。忽略湍流、絮凝和非球形颗粒。计算不驱动地形，也不预测真实沉积率。

steps.key: Locate the inner bank and point bar.
steps.zh: 找到曲流内岸和点坝。

steps.key: Compare overbank flow and a delta; change the separate settling experiment.
steps.zh: 比较漫滩水流与三角洲，再改变独立的颗粒沉降实验。

steps.key: Explain sediment supply, transport and deposition with the stated assumptions.
steps.zh: 在明确假设下解释沉积物的供应、搬运与沉积。

steps.key: 4 questions with explanations. Give a reason for each choice; there is no score gate.
steps.zh: 4 道题，附解析。请说明选择理由。

script.key:
Locate the inside of the bend and its point bar.
Choose Overbank floodplain; toggle water to expose the low natural levees.
Compare Delta mouth with an estuary photograph.
Halve Grain diameter and use the squared-diameter relation to predict settling speed.
Explain why still-water settling alone cannot predict a real flood deposit.
Finish in Check.
script.zh:
找到曲流内岸和点坝。
比较漫滩水流与三角洲，再改变独立的颗粒沉降实验。
在明确假设下解释沉积物的供应、搬运与沉积。
最后完成自测，请学生说明判断依据。

pitfalls.key: UK ‘deltas’ that are estuaries.
pitfalls.zh: 把河口湾误称为三角洲。

pitfalls.key: Mixing inner-bank deposition with outer-bank erosion.
pitfalls.zh: 混淆内岸沉积与外岸侵蚀。

pitfalls.key: Teaching levées as only an engineering product.
pitfalls.zh: 认为天然堤只能由工程建造。

misconceptions.key: Every river builds a delta.
misconceptions.zh: 每条河都形成三角洲。

misconceptions.key: Tides and waves can steal the load. Many UK mouths are estuaries.
misconceptions.zh: 潮汐和波浪可带走泥沙，许多河口是河口湾。

misconceptions.key: The outer bank is where the river dumps sand.
misconceptions.zh: 河弯外侧主要堆沙。

misconceptions.key: Outer is the cut bank. Inner is the slip-off slope. Helicoidal flow.
misconceptions.zh: 典型曲流内侧沉积边滩，外侧侵蚀河岸。

misconceptions.key: Levées are only built by engineers.
misconceptions.zh: 所有堤岸都是工程师建的。

misconceptions.key: Natural levées are coarse flood deposits on the banks. Engineers copy them.
misconceptions.zh: 反复漫滩可自然形成沿河的天然堤。

objective.key: Trace headward erosion, identify a capture elbow and explain the loss of headwater supply from a beheaded reach.
